nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46475-0.comments: Solid detection performance with efficient architecture; Grad-CAM++ visualizations provide good interpretability, but cross-dataset generalization not tested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-scale attention and Vision Transformer improve crack feature discrimination across scales and low-contrast scenarios
hypotheses.result: mAP@0.5=0.897, mAP@0.5:0.95=0.706; 6.6% improvement over baseline YOLOv8

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47339-3.task: Thermal enhancement of Trombe walls with ribbed surfaces via 3D CFD optimization
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47339-3.key_results: Rib density Nr = 5 with appropriate geometry increases Nusselt number by 68.3% (Re = 1600); triangular ribs yield highest thermal gain (99.4% Nu increase) but high friction penalty; semi-circular ribs optimize trade-off (TEF = 1.51)
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47339-3.comments: The parametric study clearly demonstrates that optimal rib design requires balancing heat transfer enhancement against pressure drop, with semi-circular geometry offering practical efficiency for nZEB applications.

model_io.model: 3D Trombe wall with ribbed channel (ANSYS Fluent, laminar Re = 600–1600)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ribbed surfaces enhance Trombe wall performance; optimal geometry balances thermal and friction effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Nr = 5 with semi-circular ribs achieves TEF = 1.51

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47572-w.task: High-temperature thermoelectric properties of half-metallic double perovskites Cs2MBr6
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47572-w.key_results: Half-metallic ferromagnetism (100% spin polarization) confirmed for all compositions; Seebeck coefficient 400–1000 μV/K at room temperature; ZT ≈ 0.83–0.99 (300–1000 K); exceptional thermostability
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47572-w.comments: The combination of robust half-metallicity with high thermoelectric efficiency is rare and offers promising prospects for spin-based energy conversion devices.

model_io.model: Cs2MBr6 double perovskites (M = Mn, Mo, Ta, Ir) DFT calculations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spin-selective transport in half-metals yields high thermoelectric performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ZT ≈ 0.83–0.99 achieved via large spin-dependent band gaps

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47901-z.task: Transient ionization and mode-coupling in helicon plasma discharge
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47901-z.key_results: Rapid density rise within ~10−4 s with two-peak electron temperature structure; RF energy redistribution characterized during ignition; sensitivity revealed to gas pressure, magnetic field, and driving frequency
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47901-z.comments: The fully coupled multiphysics model provides predictive insights into RF plasma dynamics, though computational cost may limit real-time optimization applications.

model_io.model: Self-consistent helicon discharge model (COMSOL: Maxwell + energy transport + kinetics + chemistry)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transient ionization involves two-stage RF energy redistribution and mode coupling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; localized energy deposition followed by field restructuring observed

hf:2604.04707.task: Unified inference framework for world models
hf:2604.04707.key_results: Standardized definition and categorization of world model capabilities; integrated framework enabling efficient model reuse
hf:2604.04707.comments: Provides valuable infrastructure but is primarily a systems contribution without novel algorithmic or empirical breakthroughs.

hf:2604.04771.key_results: 95.69% on OmniDocBench v1.6 (+2.71pp over same-architecture baseline), 65.5M training samples via data engineering alone with fixed 1.2B architecture
hf:2604.04771.comments: Demonstrates that training data quality and scale can outweigh architectural innovation; notable for achieving SOTA without model changes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Performance bottlenecks stem from training data deficiencies rather than architecture
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via SOTA results from data engineering alone

hf:2604.04921.task: KV cache compression for extended reasoning
hf:2604.04921.key_results: 2.5x throughput improvement or 10.7x KV memory reduction on AIME25 32K-token generation while matching full attention accuracy; baselines achieve only ~50% accuracy at same efficiency
hf:2604.04921.comments: Novel trigonometric approach to understanding Q/K concentration is elegant; enables practical deployment of long-context reasoning on consumer hardware.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pre-RoPE Q/K vectors concentrate around fixed centers, determining distance preferences via trigonometric series
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enables stable key importance estimation

hf:2604.04184.task: Real-time streaming video understanding and interaction
hf:2604.04184.key_results: State-of-the-art on streaming benchmarks; 2 FPS real-time demo on two 80G GPUs with ASR/TTS integration
hf:2604.04184.comments: Strong system for practical deployment; contributions span context management, training objectives, and inference optimization rather than novel reasoning approaches.

hf:2603.28301.task: Paraphrase robustness evaluation for VLA models
hf:2603.28301.key_results: 22-52pp performance degradation under paraphrasing across 0.6B-7.5B models; 80-96% of failures from planning-level trajectory divergence; PRIDE metric quantifies difficulty via semantic/syntactic factors
hf:2603.28301.comments: Reveals critical gap in VLA semantic grounding; PRIDE metric provides fine-grained difficulty assessment beyond binary success.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Paraphrasing disrupts task identification more than execution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 80-96% of failures are trajectory divergence, not execution errors

hf:2604.04911.task: Fine-grained image spatial editing benchmark and model
hf:2604.04911.key_results: SpatialEdit-16B outperforms prior methods on spatial manipulation; synthetic dataset SpatialEdit-500k provides precise ground-truth transformations; benchmark jointly measures perceptual plausibility and geometric fidelity
hf:2604.04911.comments: Addresses data bottleneck for spatial editing through controllable synthesis; useful benchmark but incremental on architectural front.

hf:2604.04901.task: File-system grounded agent personalization and memory
hf:2604.04901.key_results: FileGramBench shows SOTA memory systems remain challenged on profile reconstruction, trace disentanglement, persona drift; FileGramEngine generates 65.5M+ multimodal action sequences; bottom-up memory outperforms dialogue-based approaches
hf:2604.04901.comments: Tackles real constraint of privacy/multimodal data collection via simulation; memory architecture design is pragmatic for co-workers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bottom-up memory from atomic actions outperforms dialogue-summary-based approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via FileGramBench

hf:2604.02176.task: Textual frequency optimization for LLM prompting and fine-tuning
hf:2604.02176.key_results: Textual Frequency Law (TFL) framework effective on math reasoning, MT, commonsense reasoning, tool-calling; Curriculum Textual Frequency Training outperforms baselines
hf:2604.02176.comments: Proposes underexplored dimension (sentence-level frequency); however, evaluation is limited to in-house dataset and lacks comparison with simpler baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frequent textual expressions improve LLM performance for both prompting and fine-tuning
hypotheses.result: Supported by experiments on TFPD dataset

hf:2604.04202.task: Evaluating agents in evolving information environments
hf:2604.04202.key_results: 64 scenarios, 1,879 evaluation rounds across 8 professional domains; model capability ranges 15.4%, framework design 9.2%; belief revision difficulty determined by update strategy not update frequency
hf:2604.04202.comments: ClawArena captures real-world complexity (multi-source conflicts, dynamic updates, implicit personalization); fills important benchmark gap.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Belief revision difficulty depends on update design strategy rather than update presence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via scenario analysis

hf:2604.03679.task: Efficient reasoning via dynamic thought compression and memory management
hf:2604.03679.key_results: LightThinker: 70% peak token reduction, 26% inference speedup; LightThinker++: 69.9% token reduction with +2.42% accuracy gain; agentic tasks: 60-70% footprint reduction over 80 rounds with 14.8% avg performance gain
hf:2604.03679.comments: Practical solution to reasoning overhead; evolution from compression to explicit memory primitives is well-motivated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Static compression fails on complex reasoning; explicit memory primitives enable stable long-horizon tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LightThinker++ maintains stability beyond 80 rounds

hf:2604.02288.task: Unified on-policy RL framework combining reward-aligned and logit-level supervision
hf:2604.02288.key_results: SRPO raises Qwen3-8B average by 3.4% over GRPO, 6.3% over SDPO on five benchmarks; achieves rapid early improvement of SDPO and long-horizon stability of GRPO; 17.2% compute cost reduction
hf:2604.02288.comments: Sample routing elegantly unifies two complementary objectives; entropy-aware weighting addresses instability without ad-hoc hyperparameters.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SDPO's late-stage instability stems from distillation on correct samples and degrading teacher signal
hypotheses.result: Addressed via sample routing; SRPO stabilizes training

hf:2604.04804.task: Automated skill knowledge base construction for LLM agents
hf:2604.04804.key_results: Three-tiered skill hierarchy (strategic plans, functional skills, atomic); transferable across AppWorld, BFCL-v3, τ²-Bench; improves weaker agent performance
hf:2604.04804.comments: SkillX addresses inefficient agent learning via structured, hierarchical experience representation; practical framework for skill reuse.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical skill representation generalizes better than flat trajectory storage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via transfer to weaker agents

hf:2604.03253.key_results: Consistent improvements over standard reasoning on competitive programming benchmarks; execution simulation enables self-verification and iterative fixing
hf:2604.03253.comments: Grounding code understanding in step-by-step execution is intuitive; method combines SFT, explanation grounding, and RL effectively.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training on execution simulation improves code generation through self-verification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via competitive programming benchmarks

hf:2604.04917.task: Visual reasoning via open RL recipe across diverse tasks
hf:2604.04917.key_results: Vero-600K achieves 3.7-5.5pp improvements over four base models; outperforms Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking on 23/30 benchmarks without proprietary thinking data; task-routed rewards handle heterogeneous formats
hf:2604.04917.comments: Broad data coverage emerges as primary RL scaling driver; fully open recipe contrasts with proprietary baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different task categories elicit distinct reasoning patterns with poor isolation transfer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; broad data coverage is primary scaling driver

hf:2604.04759.task: Real-world safety evaluation of personal AI agents
hf:2604.04759.key_results: 24.6% baseline attack success rate increases to 64-74% under single CIK dimension poisoning; strongest defense yields 63.8% under capability-targeted attacks; file protection blocks 97% malicious but prevents 100% legitimate updates
hf:2604.04759.comments: First real-world OpenClaw evaluation on live instance; reveals architectural vulnerabilities inherent to broad system access.

model_io.model: OpenClaw (Claude Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.4)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vulnerabilities are architectural, not model-specific
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; threefold increase in baseline vulnerability across all models

hf:2604.02073.task: Universal multimodal embedding with latent reasoning
hf:2604.02073.key_results: PLUME outperforms explicit-CoT baselines on MMEB-v2 (78 tasks); reduces reasoning from hundreds of tokens to <10 latent steps; 30x faster inference
hf:2604.02073.comments: Latent reasoning pathway elegantly avoids textual bottleneck; progressive explicit-to-latent curriculum is effective training strategy.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent reasoning preserves benefits of intermediate reasoning without explicit-CoT overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 30x faster with better performance

hf:2604.04838.task: Visual Question Answering via strategic image degradation
hf:2604.04838.key_results: Degradation-Driven Prompting improves VQA on physical attributes and perceptual phenomena; downsampling + structural aids force focus on essential information
hf:2604.04838.comments: Counter-intuitive finding that less detail improves reasoning; effective use of prompt engineering and input degradation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-resolution details become noise; strategic degradation improves reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on physical attributes and perceptual phenomena tasks

hf:2604.04503.task: Memory-based deep research agents with parametric-nonparametric integration
hf:2604.04503.key_results: Manager-Planner-Executor architecture with test-time learning; bidirectional conversion between parametric and non-parametric memory; improvements across eleven benchmarks
hf:2604.04503.comments: Memory Intelligence Agent framework integrates multiple mechanisms (alternating RL, test-time learning, reflection); strong empirical results but contributions are engineering-heavy.

hf:2604.00830.task: Learning optimal adaptation policies for test-time language agents
hf:2604.00830.key_results: Meta-TTL outperforms hand-crafted baselines on Jericho and WebArena-Lite in both ID and OOD settings; formulates adaptation policy discovery as bi-level optimization
hf:2604.00830.comments: Shifts from engineering to learning adaptation policies; evolutionary search over task distribution provides principled approach.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned adaptation policies generalize better than hand-crafted ones
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across ID and OOD settings

hf:2604.04780.task: Degraded image understanding via generative-reasoning integration
hf:2604.04780.key_results: CLEAR substantially improves robustness on degraded inputs while preserving clean performance; Latent Representation Bridge enables direct optimization; intermediate visual states have higher perceptual quality than pixel-level reconstruction
hf:2604.04780.comments: Clever use of generative pathway for degradation robustness; Interleaved GRPO jointly optimizes text and visual generation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generative capacity can model fine-grained structure lost to degradation; task-driven optimization aligns with visual quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CLEAR improves robustness and perceptual quality

hf:2604.03993.task: Robust reasoning under noisy labels in RLVR
hf:2604.03993.key_results: Online Label Refinement (OLR) improves robustness by 3.6-3.9% on in-distribution, 3.3-4.6% on out-of-distribution under noise ratios 0.1-0.9; identifies Early Correctness Coherence phenomenon
hf:2604.03993.comments: Systematic analysis of noise in RLVR distinguishes inactive vs. active noise; progressive label correction is pragmatic.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rollout-based RLVR naturally extends to noisy labels; inactive noise reduces efficiency, active noise skews distribution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; OLR corrects through majority voting and consistency

hf:2604.04787.task: 4D Gaussian avatar generation from single portrait
hf:2604.04787.key_results: AvatarPointillist generates photorealistic, controllable avatars; autoregressive point generation with adaptive density; joint prediction of binding information enables realistic animation
hf:2604.04787.comments: Novel autoregressive formulation for avatar generation; decoder-only transformer sequentially constructs Gaussian splatting points.

hf:2604.04522.task: Cryptographic protocol for human delegation provenance in agentic AI
hf:2604.04522.key_results: HDP token binds authorization to session, records append-only delegation chain, enables offline verification via Ed25519; published as IETF Internet-Draft; addresses multi-hop human-provenance gap
hf:2604.04522.comments: Systems contribution addressing accountability in multi-agent delegation; lightweight design without registry lookups.

hf:2604.03687.task: Long-tailed classification in scientific image domains
hf:2604.03687.key_results: SciLT exploits multi-level representations via adaptive fusion; balanced performance across head/tail classes on three scientific benchmarks; outperforms existing methods with parameter-efficient fine-tuning
hf:2604.03687.comments: Addresses domain gap between natural and scientific images; penultimate-layer features critical for tail class performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Penultimate-layer features critical for tail classes under domain shift
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dual-supervision on multiple levels improves balance

hf:2604.04562.task: Automated discovery, summarization, and trend analysis of arXiv papers
hf:2604.04562.key_results: Paper Espresso processed 13,300+ papers over 35 months; revealed mid-2025 RL surge, 6,673 unique topics, 2.0x upvote correlation with novelty; multi-granularity trend analysis
hf:2604.04562.comments: Infrastructure for research landscape monitoring; demonstrates value of LLM-driven paper analysis at scale.

hf:2604.04155.task: Evaluating geometric fidelity of foundation models for biology/physics
hf:2604.04155.key_results: Geometric Alignment Tax: 8.5x distortion reduction from discrete to continuous heads; learned codebooks exhibit non-monotonic double bind; 14 biological models show 3 failure regimes (Local-Global Decoupling, Representational Compression, Geometric Vacuity)
hf:2604.04155.comments: Reveals fundamental tension between discrete tokenization and continuous geometry; rate-distortion analysis is rigorous.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discrete categorical bottleneck systematically fails to preserve continuous system geometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; continuous heads achieve 8.5x lower distortion

hf:2604.03695.key_results: POEMetric assesses 30 LLMs on 6,090 poems vs. 203 human poems; top model: form accuracy 4.26/5, theme 4.99; humans exceed on creativity (4.02), idiosyncrasy (3.95), emotional resonance (4.06), imagery (4.49), devices (4.67); overall poem quality humans 4.22 vs. LLM 3.20
hf:2604.03695.comments: First comprehensive poetry evaluation; humans remain superior on advanced literary capabilities despite strong form/theme performance by LLMs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs can follow form/theme instructions but fail on creativity and emotional resonance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; all models lag on advanced abilities

nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03760-6.task: Define hypoxia-induced XBP1s-MYDGF axis suppression of ferroptosis in gastric cancer
nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03760-6.key_results: Hypoxia activates XBP1 splicing to promote MYDGF expression; MYDGF competes with UBQLN1 at STI1-4 domain, blocking ERAD of LCN2; stabilized LCN2 sequesters iron and inhibits ferroptosis; disruption of axis sensitizes cells to ferroptosis inducers in vitro and in vivo
nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03760-6.comments: Elegant mechanistic axis linking hypoxia to ferroptosis evasion; structural detail on MYDGF-UBQLN1 binding warrants crystallographic validation; therapeutic potential in hypoxic tumors is compelling.

outputs: Increased ferroptosis sensitivity in vitro and in vivo

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypoxia-induced XBP1s-MYDGF axis antagonizes ferroptosis via LCN2 stabilization
hypotheses.result: Genetic disruption of axis sensitizes gastric cancer cells to ferroptosis inducers both in vitro and in vivo; MYDGF blocks UBQLN1-mediated LCN2 ERAD

nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03762-4.task: Delineate NSUN2/ALYREF m5C modification in prostate cancer anoikis resistance
nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03762-4.key_results: ALYREF knockdown reduces prostate cancer proliferation, invasion, and metastasis; ALYREF recognizes m5C on BNIP3 mRNA, enhancing stability; BNIP3 activation promotes autophagy and anoikis resistance
nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03762-4.comments: Clear mechanistic pathway linking m5C recognition to autophagy; direct binding validation and ALYREF-BNIP3 competition assays would strengthen causation claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ALYREF-mediated m5C recognition of BNIP3 mRNA activates autophagy and promotes anoikis resistance
hypotheses.result: ALYREF knockdown reduces BNIP3 mRNA stability and autophagy; ALYREF enhances BNIP3 mRNA stability and anoikis resistance

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08672-7.task: Establish HUWE1 requirement for KRAS-driven lung adenocarcinoma
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08672-7.key_results: HUWE1 upregulation correlates with LUAD stage; Huwe1 essential for Kras-induced tumor development; HUWE1 depletion induces senescence via p53-independent mechanism
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08672-7.comments: Strong in vivo validation across multiple models; mechanistic role in SASP/NFκB signaling is demonstrated but substrate specificity in senescence induction remains partially unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: HUWE1 is essential for mutant Kras-induced lung tumorigenesis
hypotheses.result: Huwe1 depletion induces senescence and blocks tumor development in p53-independent manner

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08710-4.task: Elucidate SIRT1-KU70 axis in spermatogonial stem cell DNA damage response
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08710-4.key_results: Reduced SIRT1 expression in NOA patient SSCs correlates with attenuated NHEJ signatures; SIRT1 deacetylates KU70 to enhance NHEJ repair efficiency; SIRT1 overexpression reduces KU70 acetylation and supports SSC proliferation under genotoxic stress
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08710-4.comments: Comprehensive in vivo and in vitro validation with clinical samples; mechanistic detail on KU70 acetylation is well-supported but acetylation sites and broader KU70 functions merit deeper analysis.

model_io.model: Human testicular tissue (NOA patients vs. controls)
In vivo/in vitro DNA damage models (X-ray, hydroxyurea)

hypotheses.hypothesis: SIRT1 maintains SSC homeostasis by deacetylating KU70 to enhance NHEJ-mediated DNA repair
hypotheses.result: SIRT1 knockdown reduces NHEJ repair; SIRT1 overexpression decreases KU70 acetylation and promotes SSC survival under genotoxic stress

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-70699-3.task: Identify chromatin-based vulnerabilities in SWI/SNF-mutant cancers
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-70699-3.key_results: PHIP is a dependency in SWI/SNF-disrupted cancers; PHIP ubiquitinates NuRD complex subunits to antagonize repressive activity; SWI/SNF loss causes NuRD accumulation at promoters requiring PHIP for transcriptional activation
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-70699-3.comments: Robust CRISPR screening and mechanistic elegance; direct PHIP-NuRD interaction topology and substrate specificity merit structural characterization.

model_io.model: Genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screening in cancer cell lines
outputs: PHIP identified as dependency in SWI/SNF-disrupted cancers

hypotheses.hypothesis: PHIP antagonizes NuRD repression to enable SWI/SNF-mutant cancer growth
hypotheses.result: PHIP ubiquitinates NuRD subunits; loss of SWI/SNF causes NuRD accumulation at promoters; PHIP suppression of NuRD is required for transcriptional activation

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71425-9.task: Map isoform diversity in oocytes during maturation
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71425-9.key_results: 7154 novel human and 4875 novel mouse isoforms identified; ~30% of novel isoforms derived from transposable elements; ARHGAP18 novel isoforms enhance stability and affect microtubule localization
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71425-9.comments: Valuable resource but functional validation limited to one gene; transposable element contribution to isoform stability is mechanistically under-explored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transposable elements incorporated in transcripts enhance isoform stability
hypotheses.result: ~30% of NNC isoforms contain transposable elements; enhanced stability during oocyte maturation

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71514-9.task: Characterize cellular composition and stem cell populations in laryngeal mucosa
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71514-9.key_results: Identified SOX9-positive and Lgr5-positive stem cell subpopulations in vocal fold; generated three types of epithelial organoids; revealed supraglottis/subglottis pseudostratified columnar epithelium differences
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71514-9.comments: Useful transcriptomic and spatial resource; limited functional characterization of stem cell populations and organoid-derived tissues.

model_io.model: Single-cell RNA-sequencing and spatial transcriptomics (mouse laryngeal mucosa)

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71516-7.task: Define pathogenic mechanisms and ASO therapy for NOTCH2NLC GGC repeat expansion disease
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71516-7.key_results: PolyG aggregates disrupt nucleolar homeostasis and chromatin organization via CTCF/RAD21 downregulation; ASO treatment reduces aggregates and alleviates senescence (brain organoids from patient samples)
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71516-7.comments: Comprehensive mechanistic study; proof-of-concept ASO efficacy in organoids is promising but requires in vivo validation.

model_io.model: Patient-derived brain organoids (neuronal intranuclear inclusion disease)

hypotheses.hypothesis: PolyG aggregates disrupt chromatin organization via nucleophosmin mislocalization and CTCF/RAD21 downregulation
hypotheses.result: CTCF/RAD21 restoration mitigates chromatin structural defects; ASO reduces aggregates and ameliorates senescence

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-36082-4.task: Investigate synergistic apoptotic effects of Nigella sativa oil and silver nanoparticles in cervical cancer
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-36082-4.key_results: Combination of 5 µg/mL AgNPs + 150 µg/mL NS induced 29.1% early apoptosis; pro-apoptotic genes (BAX, BAK, p53, caspase-9) upregulated 3.2–4.8-fold; BCL-2 suppressed (0.28-fold)
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-36082-4.comments: Clear synergistic apoptotic induction in vitro; mechanistic characterization of complementary pathways (oxidative stress vs. epigenetic modulation) is limited; in vivo validation essential.

outputs: Gene expression (BAX, BAK, p53, caspase-9, BCL-2)

hypotheses.hypothesis: AgNPs and NS combination amplifies apoptosis through complementary mechanisms (oxidative stress and epigenetic modulation)
hypotheses.result: Combination treatment induces 29.1% early apoptosis with 3.2–4.8-fold upregulation of pro-apoptotic genes and 0.28-fold suppression of BCL-2

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46514-w.task: Investigate cardioprotective mechanism of montelukast against diclofenac-induced cardiotoxicity via Wnt/β-catenin pathway
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46514-w.key_results: DCFN treatment upregulates Wnt-1, active β-catenin, and FZD-1; increases cardiac biomarkers, oxidative stress, and apoptosis; montelukast co-treatment significantly attenuates all pathological alterations and oxidative stress markers
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46514-w.comments: Clear pathway mechanistic link and histological validation; direct evidence for Wnt/β-catenin causation in DCFN cardiotoxicity could be strengthened via Wnt pathway inhibitors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: DCFN cardiotoxicity involves Wnt/β-catenin pathway upregulation
hypotheses.result: DCFN increases Wnt-1, active β-catenin, and FZD-1 expression; montelukast attenuates pathway activation and cardiac injury

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47754-6.task: Assess 4-phenylbutyrate efficacy in mitigating hindlimb unloading-induced renal ER stress
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47754-6.key_results: Hindlimb unloading induces ER stress-associated protein dysregulation and renal pathology; 4-PBA partially attenuates alterations; GO/KEGG/Reactome analyses confirm modulation of ER stress and cytoprotective pathways
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47754-6.comments: First transcriptomic characterization of HU-induced renal changes; mechanistic depth limited—specific ER stress effectors and downstream signaling nodes warrant investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 4-PBA mitigates HU-induced renal pathology by reducing ER stress
hypotheses.result: 4-PBA treatment partially attenuates ER stress-associated protein dysregulation and renal alterations; GO/KEGG analyses confirm pathway modulation

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47843-6.task: Determine CDK9 role in multidrug resistance of ovarian cancer
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47843-6.key_results: CDK9 elevated in drug-resistant ovarian cancer cells; CDK9 inhibition enhances paclitaxel sensitivity and apoptosis; reduced Pol II and Stat3 phosphorylation; decreased spheroid formation and motility
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47843-6.comments: Clear functional evidence linking CDK9 to drug resistance; mechanism via Stat3 warrants further investigation for direct vs. indirect effects.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CDK9 inhibition enhances paclitaxel sensitivity in drug-resistant ovarian cancer
hypotheses.result: CDK9 inhibition increases apoptosis and reduces Pol II/Stat3 phosphorylation; decreased spheroid formation

nature:10.1038/s44161-026-00800-y.task: Define spastin-mediated microtubule remodeling in cardiac electrical stability
nature:10.1038/s44161-026-00800-y.key_results: Ischemia-reperfusion promotes glutamylated, stabilized microtubules via spastin; spastin deficiency impairs Cx43 trafficking and increases arrhythmia susceptibility; microtubule glutamylation inhibition preserves Cx43 localization and mitigates ischemia-reperfusion injury
nature:10.1038/s44161-026-00800-y.comments: Novel link between microtubule glutamylation and cardiac arrhythmia; spastin's role in stress response is well-demonstrated but substrate specificity beyond microtubule severing could be explored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Microtubule glutamylation impairs Cx43 trafficking and increases arrhythmia susceptibility
hypotheses.result: Spastin deficiency causes glutamylated microtubule accumulation and impaired Cx43 transport; glutamylation inhibition preserves Cx43 and prevents stress-induced arrhythmias

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71278-2.task: Large-patch restoration neural network for fluorescence imaging under photon-limited conditions
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71278-2.key_results: LargePNet achieved 0.5-2 dB higher PSNR vs. state-of-the-art; 4-fold and 20-fold efficiency gains over convolution and Transformer networks; enabled 30-hour cytoskeleton and hour-long tri-color super-resolution imaging
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71278-2.comments: Architectural innovation leveraging large receptive fields is well-motivated; practical demonstration of extended live-cell imaging is compelling, though computational requirements scale with image size.

model_io.model: LargePNet combining ultra-large-kernel shallow convolutions with deep nonlinear representations via scale separation
inputs: single-image, video, or volumetric fluorescence data under photon-limited conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large-patch training with global view statistics improves noise-resistance and fidelity over small-patch networks
hypotheses.result: LargePNet achieved 0.5-2 dB PSNR improvement; 4-20x efficiency gains; enabled extended live-cell imaging

hf:2604.05091.task: Memory-centric full-precision training of 100B+ LLMs on single GPU

model_io.model: Human pancreas and adipose biopsies with isolated islets from 31 organ donors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lipophilic pollutant accumulation in pancreas correlates with impaired glucose-stimulated insulin secretion

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47595-3.task: Determine therapeutic potential of asparagus polysaccharide in bladder cancer via PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway inhibition
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47595-3.key_results: ASP inhibits proliferation, migration, invasion and induces apoptosis in dose-dependent manner; suppresses PI3K/AKT/mTOR phosphorylation; IGF-1 co-treatment partially reverses effects
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47595-3.comments: Natural product shows pathway-selective inhibition with reversibility by pathway activator, suggesting on-target mechanism; in vivo efficacy data would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ASP exerts anticancer effects via PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway inhibition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ASP suppresses pathway phosphorylation; IGF-1 reverses phenotypes, confirming pathway dependence

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48025-0.task: Characterize differential transcriptomic and cytotoxic responses to PVP-stabilized silver nanoparticles in breast cancer vs. fibroblasts
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48025-0.key_results: AgNP exposure induces cell-type-dependent transcriptional responses; proteostasis-related pathways in HDFa; RNA processing/gene expression in MCF7; stress genes (HSPA1A/B, HMOX1) upregulated
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48025-0.comments: NGS approach reveals early mechanistic responses without overt ROS, apoptosis, or necrosis; highlights importance of nanoparticle physicochemical properties.

model_io.model: HDFa and MCF7 cells with NGS transcriptomics and functional assays
inputs: PVP-stabilized AgNP (AgNP1 and AgNP2) at 5-200 µg/mL

hypotheses.hypothesis: AgNP exposure triggers cell-type-dependent transcriptional stress responses independent of classical cytotoxic mechanisms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: AgNPs dysregulate proteostasis and ER function in HDFa; RNA processing in MCF7; no significant ROS or apoptosis

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71331-0.task: Multimodal cell type identification from electrophysiological recordings in vivo
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71331-0.key_results: PhysMAP multimodal representations align better with transcriptomic cell types than single modalities; enables label transfer and batch effect detection
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71331-0.comments: Weighting multiple electrophysiology modalities is practical but ground truth alignment depends on reference transcriptomics quality.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Weighted multimodal electrophysiology representations align better with transcriptomic cell types than single modalities
hypotheses.result: Improved alignment demonstrated; PhysMAP enables putative cell type identification without ground truth

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71364-5.task: Comprehensive review of computational tools for immunotherapy response prediction
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71364-5.key_results: Four converging paradigms (classical ML, deep learning, graph/network modeling, mechanistic systems biology); trend toward multi-modal fusion and interpretable models
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71364-5.comments: Broad scope review highlights evolution from correlational to causal modeling but lacks specific performance benchmarks.

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71558-x.task: Integrating multiple pathological foundation models for cancer detection
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71558-x.key_results: Meta-Encoder rivals best single models for univariate tasks; substantial advantages for multiplex protein/gene expression prediction in tumors
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71558-x.comments: Addresses practical limitation of data silos preventing model retraining, but depends on quality of individual foundation models.

inputs: features from multiple pathological foundation models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining complementary foundation model features improves molecular characterization over single models
hypotheses.result: Superior performance for high-dimensional protein/gene expression tasks; comparable to best single model for simple tasks

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44279-w.task: In silico screening of flavonoid inhibitors of HDAC4/HDAC8 for breast cancer
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44279-w.key_results: Luteolin, Naringenin, Scutellarin inhibit HDAC4/HDAC8; induce apoptosis in breast cancer cells; Luteolin most potent; all three suppress LPS-induced inflammation in macrophages
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44279-w.comments: Promising multi-target profiles but in vitro data only; lack of in vivo efficacy and selectivity vs. other HDACs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flavonoids inhibit HDAC4/HDAC8 to induce apoptosis and suppress inflammation in breast cancer

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47665-6.task: Privacy-preserving ECG representation learning suppressing demographic bias
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47665-6.key_results: VAE with dual-discriminator reduces soft biometric identifiability (sex 0.59, age 0.63, race 0.57 AUROC from original 0.79/0.78/0.69) while preserving reduced LVEF prediction (0.82)
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47665-6.comments: Effective privacy-utility tradeoff but modest clinical performance retention; generalization to other cardiac conditions untested.

hypotheses.result: Reduced soft biometric identifiability achieved with minimal clinical prediction degradation

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47731-z.task: Fine-tuned multi-deep neural networks for breast cancer stage classification
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47731-z.key_results: FT-MDNNMDs achieves 99.57% accuracy, 99.46% MCC, 99.63% recall; outperforms SVM (94.46%), Decision Trees (93.54%), Naïve Bayes (91.22%)
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47731-z.comments: High reported accuracy but risk of overfitting given modest external validation; private dataset limits reproducibility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transfer learning and fine-tuning on multi-dataset model improves breast cancer stage classification
hypotheses.result: FT-MDNNMDs achieved 99.57% accuracy and 1.5–3.0% improvement over existing methods

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48493-4.task: Machine learning prediction of postoperative bladder cancer recurrence
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48493-4.key_results: XGBoost model AUC 0.960 (train), 0.925 (validation), 0.850 (external); identified 11 independent predictors including NLR, tumor stage, smoking history
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48493-4.comments: Robust cross-validation and interpretability via SHAP strengthen clinical utility; external validation AUC decline suggests potential generalization gap.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48821-8.task: Machine learning detection of oral squamous cell carcinoma via tumor-associated autoantibodies
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48821-8.key_results: Five TAAbs (anti-BLM, anti-BUB1, anti-KIF18A, anti-KIF2C, anti-TPX2) identified; Naive Bayes model AUC 0.75 (train), 0.66 (validation); anti-KIF2C most predictive
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48821-8.comments: Modest validation AUC (0.66) limits clinical utility; autoantibody panel specificity for OSCC vs. other cancers unclear.

model_io.model: Naive Bayes and seven other ML algorithms

hypotheses.hypothesis: Five tumor-associated autoantibodies enable early OSCC detection via machine learning
hypotheses.result: Naive Bayes model achieved AUC 0.75 training, 0.66 validation; anti-KIF2C most contributory

nature:10.1038/s41746-026-02476-x.task: Regulatory reform for FDA New Approach Methodologies replacing animal testing
nature:10.1038/s41746-026-02476-x.key_results: Proposal for regulatory reforms enabling transition to NAMs, digital twins, and in silico trials for drug evaluation
nature:10.1038/s41746-026-02476-x.comments: Policy-focused perspective identifying regulatory gaps; lacks technical validation of NAM-to-human translation equivalence.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47847-2.task: Decentralized sensor fault-tolerant control for DC microgrids
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47847-2.key_results: ADRC controller maintains stability under single, consecutive, simultaneous sensor faults; better voltage regulation, faster transient recovery, improved robustness vs. PI and ellipsoidal methods on multi-DG microgrid
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47847-2.comments: Active disturbance rejection avoids explicit fault detection/reconfiguration; lumped disturbance estimation via extended state observer.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ADRC preserves stability under unknown time-varying sensor faults without explicit fault detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; simulations show robust performance across fault scenarios

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48794-8.task: Explainable student satisfaction clustering and ranking in online learning
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48794-8.key_results: FAHP-TOPSIS-SHAP-LIME framework segments 1,469 students into 3 satisfaction cohorts (low n=852, medium n=484, high n=133); high satisfaction linked to emotional positivity and self-efficacy; low satisfaction driven by affordability and stress
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48794-8.comments: Comprehensive hybrid framework combining ANOVA, SHAP, LIME, FAHP, TOPSIS, and hierarchical clustering; results align with TAM/UTAUT/SDT constructs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Feature importance varies across satisfaction subgroups
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cluster-specific SHAP/LIME patterns identified

nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02623-6.task: Bifurcation analysis of soliton hopping in coupled microresonators
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02623-6.key_results: Periodic orbit solutions of Lugiato-Lefever equations identified; dimers: hopping from stable soliton branch; trimers: from unstable branch (lower pump power); subcritical Hopf bifurcations explain hysteresis and multiple attractors
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02623-6.comments: Dynamical systems approach reveals fundamental difference in dimers vs. trimers; bifurcation theory guides experimental design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Soliton hopping originates from distinct bifurcation mechanisms in dimers vs. trimers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; stable branch (dimers) vs. unstable branch (trimers)

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71911-0.task: Enable tunable electrocaloric cooling via calcium doping of lead scandium tantalate
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71911-0.key_results: Transition temperature shift from 258 K to 319 K with Ca doping; adiabatic temperature change of 2 K spanning 263–353 K; emergence of intermediate antiferroelectric phase
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71911-0.comments: Extends PST electrocaloric range below freezing point, enabling cascaded cooling, but practical integration into multi-stage devices requires further engineering.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A-site Ca doping modifies PST phase transitions and electrocaloric response
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: transition temperature tunable 258–319 K; intermediate antiferroelectric phase emerges

nature:10.1038/s41535-026-00878-4.task: Determine how pairing mechanism dictates topological properties in valley-polarized superconductors
nature:10.1038/s41535-026-00878-4.key_results: Short-range (phonon) interactions favor BdG Chern number same sign as Berry curvature; overscreened repulsive (Kohn-Luttinger) interactions favor opposite sign
nature:10.1038/s41535-026-00878-4.comments: Provides experimental criterion for distinguishing pairing mechanisms, though applicability to observed chiral superconductivity in multilayer graphene requires confirmation.

model_io.model: valley-polarized superconductor with Berry curvature and tunable pairing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pairing mechanism determines sign of BdG Chern number relative to Berry curvature
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: phonon interactions favor same sign; Kohn-Luttinger favors opposite sign

nature:10.1038/s41612-026-01414-8.task: Quantify longwave radiation modulation in blackbody cloud dynamics
nature:10.1038/s41612-026-01414-8.key_results: Upper-cloud cooling increases with liquid water path (LWP) beyond ~100 g m⁻²; modulation alters stratocumulus dynamics, entrainment, and organization
nature:10.1038/s41612-026-01414-8.comments: Challenges conventional assumption that longwave radiation is negligible in blackbody clouds, but implications for climate models require broader validation.

model_io.model: radiative transfer calculations and high-resolution cloud simulations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Longwave radiation effects are negligible in blackbody clouds
hypotheses.result: Disproven: cooling modulation alters dynamics and entrainment significantly

nature:10.1038/s41699-026-00693-2.task: Clarify intra- and interlayer electron-phonon interaction in bilayer graphene via isotope labeling
nature:10.1038/s41699-026-00693-2.key_results: G, R, R' peaks originate from intralayer el-ph interaction; 2G, G+R', 2R' peaks near 3170 cm⁻¹ from interlayer el-ph interaction; resonance mechanisms identified
nature:10.1038/s41699-026-00693-2.comments: Isotope-labeling Raman spectroscopy provides clear separation of coupling mechanisms, though twist-angle dependence suggests further work needed on moiré effects.

model_io.model: bilayer graphene with isotope-labeled atoms and Raman spectroscopy

hypotheses.hypothesis: G, R, R' peaks reflect intralayer and 2G, G+R', 2R' peaks reflect interlayer el-ph interaction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with isotope labeling; resonance conditions identified for each peak type

hf:2604.14148.key_results: Supports 4-15s video generation at 480p/720p; accepts 3 video clips, 9 images, 3 audio clips as reference; performance on par with leading models
hf:2604.14148.comments: Industrial release demonstrates practical scalability of multi-modal generation, though quantitative comparisons with competitors are not provided.

hf:2604.11626.task: Improving visual generation via structured reward reasoning
hf:2604.11626.key_results: RationalRewards (8B) achieves state-of-the-art preference prediction with 10-20x less training data; test-time critique-and-refine matches RL fine-tuning; improves text-to-image and image-editing generators
hf:2604.11626.comments: Clever use of multi-dimensional rationales as optimization signals; PARROT framework avoids expensive rationale annotation through distillation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured rationales improve both training (as RL rewards) and test time (via prompt revision)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Generate-Critique-Refine loop matches RL-based fine-tuning on several benchmarks

hf:2604.14144.key_results: Highest average score at 3B and 7B scales across nine benchmarks; consistent gains on spatial reasoning with no degradation on general visual understanding
hf:2604.14144.comments: Deterministic Geometric Environment is elegant: exploits that 3D ground truth is computable from geometry without model consensus, avoiding self-reinforcement of errors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic geometric validation enables self-evolution without model consensus bias
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: DGE constraints and task-adaptive scheduling achieve state-of-the-art performance

hf:2604.10866.task: Evaluating AI agents on professional occupational tasks
hf:2604.10866.key_results: Benchmark covers 100 scenarios across 10 industries and 65 domains; implicit faults harder than explicit errors; GPT-5.2 gains 27.5 points with higher reasoning effort
hf:2604.10866.comments: Language World Models enable cheap, scalable domain simulation; reveals that no model dominates all industries and that environmental robustness is often overlooked.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Implicit faults (data degradation) are harder to handle than explicit errors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: implicit faults lack overt error signals, requiring independent detection

hf:2604.14004.task: Cross-domain memory transfer for coding agents
hf:2604.14004.key_results: Cross-domain memory improves average performance by 3.7%; transfer effectiveness scales with memory pool size; high-level insights transfer better than low-level traces
hf:2604.14004.comments: Meta-knowledge (validation routines) transfers across domains while task-specific code causes negative transfer—nuanced insight on abstraction level's role in transferability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Abstraction level dictates cross-domain memory transferability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: high-level insights generalize; low-level traces induce negative transfer

hf:2604.14142.task: Reinforcement learning in pre-train space to enhance reasoning
hf:2604.14142.key_results: NSR-PreRL increases transition and reflection thoughts by 14.89x and 6.54x; DSRL outperforms strong baselines; negative sample reinforcement is highly effective driver
hf:2604.14142.comments: Key insight that optimizing P(y) rather than P(y|x) bypasses base model limitations; mechanism of NSR (pruning incorrect reasoning) is well-motivated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strong gradient alignment exists between log P(y) and log P(y|x), making PreRL viable
hypotheses.result: Confirmed theoretically and empirically; NSR emerges as exceptionally effective mechanism

hf:2604.06159.task: Policy gradient optimization via explicit target distribution
hf:2604.06159.key_results: TPO matches or outperforms PG, PPO, GRPO, DG on easy tasks; substantially outperforms under sparse reward on billion-parameter LLM RLVR and tabular bandits
hf:2604.06159.comments: Clever decoupling: separating target distribution construction from parameter updates allows cleaner optimization dynamics with loss gradient p^θ - q that vanishes at convergence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupling target distribution and parameter updates improves optimization under sparse rewards
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: TPO substantially outperforms standard policy-gradient methods on sparse reward tasks

hf:2604.11548.task: General-purpose personal AI agents via harness engineering
hf:2604.11548.key_results: Open-source multi-agent framework with DAG-based orchestration, PermissionBridge safety system, three-tier context management; supports persistent collaborative relationships
hf:2604.11548.comments: Positions 'harness engineering' as primary differentiation as model capabilities converge; shifts focus from prompt engineering to infrastructure for reliability and auditability.

hf:2604.14048.key_results: Average improvement 3.73% in camera pose accuracy, 2.88% in point map prediction; <2 min LoRA update per dataset; improves Depth Anything 3 and VGGT without 3D ground truth
hf:2604.14048.comments: Elegant self-supervision via view masking exploits that more views yield more reliable reconstructions; avoids need for expensive 3D annotation at test time.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-view feature consistency under frame masking enables test-time self-evolution without 3D ground truth
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: consistent improvements across 4 benchmarks with lightweight LoRA updates

hf:2604.11045.task: Decoupling AI coding agent engine into embeddable infrastructure
hf:2604.11045.key_results: Core engine as standalone npm library; powers VSCode extension and multi-channel messaging gateway (SemaClaw) from identical reasoning kernel; 8 key mechanisms for multi-tenant reliability
hf:2604.11045.comments: Architectural contribution: separates reasoning engine from delivery form, enabling code reuse across heterogeneous developer environments.

hf:2604.14084.task: Efficient on-policy knowledge distillation via token importance
hf:2604.14084.key_results: Entropy-based sampling: 50% of tokens match all-token training, reduce peak memory by 47%; <10% of overconfident tokens nearly match full-token baselines; Q3-only <20% tokens surpass full OPD
hf:2604.14084.comments: Two-axis taxonomy (entropy vs. teacher-student divergence) reveals overconfident tokens carry dense corrective signal despite being entropy-blind; explains why entropy alone is incomplete.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Overconfident (low-entropy, high-divergence) tokens carry more learning signal than entropy alone captures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: <10% overconfident tokens nearly match full-token training; two-axis selection rules more effective

hf:2604.14113.task: Adaptive zoom-in for GUI element grounding
hf:2604.14113.key_results: Gains of +13.4% on ScreenSpot-Pro, +10.3% on UI-Vision, +4.2% on ScreenSpot-v2; training-free; handles small icons and dense layouts
hf:2604.14113.comments: Training-free uncertainty quantification approach; cleverly decomposes variance into spatial spread and box extent for per-instance crop radius.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Uncertainty-driven crop sizing outperforms uniform zoom-in across instances
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: adaptive approach achieves significant gains without training

hf:2604.07882.key_results: 21.64 PSNR future prediction vs 13.27 optimization baseline; Chamfer Distance 0.004 vs 0.349; <1s inference vs hours; enables fast simulation-ready asset generation
hf:2604.07882.comments: Novel feedforward + dual-branch architecture self-supervises physics without ground-truth labels; dramatic speedup enables practical robotics/graphics applications.

hf:2604.14116.task: Automating LLM fine-tuning via multi-agent tree-based exploration
hf:2604.14116.key_results: Multi-agent system (Researcher + Executor) automates entire training lifecycle; FT-Bench benchmark with 10 real-world tasks demonstrates consistent performance optimization
hf:2604.14116.comments: Treats iterative training as tree search with reusable results and insight distillation; addresses practical automation gap between isolated scientific tasks and complex workflows.

hf:2604.13151.task: Quantifying exploration and exploitation errors in LM agents
hf:2604.13151.key_results: Frontier LM agents struggle significantly; reasoning models solve more effectively; both errors improvable via minimal harness engineering
hf:2604.13151.comments: Controllable grid/DAG environments enable policy-agnostic evaluation without internal access; reveals that stronger agents improve both through better tool use, not token consumption.

inputs: partially observable 2D grid, unknown task DAG

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reasoning models exhibit superior exploration-exploitation balance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: reasoning models solve tasks more effectively with improvable errors via harness engineering

hf:2604.13418.task: Evaluating search-augmented agents on multimodal evidence retrieval
hf:2604.13418.key_results: Average accuracy 22.3% across agents; best agent 40.1%; Gemini Deep Research overexplores (more steps/tools) yet achieves modest gains; humans outperform agents with fewer resources
hf:2604.13418.comments: Reveals critical gap between benchmark performance and real-world robustness; agents inefficient at source selection and over-rely on text despite multimodal tasks.

inputs: natural language query without modality cues

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stronger agents achieve higher accuracy but with diminishing returns due to distraction by conflicting web content
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: gains modest despite more steps/tools; reveals need for robust multimodal source selection

hf:2604.13822.task: Long-horizon GUI automation with tool-integrated policy optimization
hf:2604.13822.key_results: UI-Copilot-7B achieves SOTA on MemGUI-Bench; 17.1% absolute improvement on AndroidWorld over base Qwen; outperforms GUI-Owl-7B and UI-TARS-1.5-7B
hf:2604.13822.comments: Memory decoupling + selective tool invocation (TIPO) elegantly addresses memory degradation and math hallucination; strong generalization to real-world tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Separating tool selection (single-turn) from task execution (multi-turn) improves long-horizon performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: TIPO achieves SOTA via decoupled optimization; memory decoupling addresses context degradation

hf:2604.09409.task: Empirical study of AI coding agent logging practices
hf:2604.09409.key_results: Agents change logging less than humans (58.4% of repos); higher log density when they do; explicit instructions rare (4.7%) and ineffective (67% non-compliance); humans repair 72.5% of logs
hf:2604.09409.comments: Reveals dual failure in natural language instruction for logging; agents as 'silent code generators' leaving observability debt for human 'janitors' to fix.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit natural language logging instructions effectively govern agent logging practices
hypotheses.result: Rejected: instructions rare and ineffective; agents fail to comply 67% of time

hf:2604.14147.task: Segmenting novel and emerging entities via retrieval enhancement
hf:2604.14147.key_results: ROSE outperforms Gemini-2.0 Flash baseline by 19.2 in gIoU on NEST benchmark; plug-and-play framework augments any MLLM-based segmentation model
hf:2604.14147.comments: NEST task and benchmark address real problem: MLLMs struggle with novel/emerging entities; retrieval-augmented generation + visual/textual enhancement is practical solution.

hf:2604.13201.key_results: None of 15+ evaluated models exceed 45% accuracy; recognizing unanswerable questions is major weakness; stronger models use tools more effectively
hf:2604.13201.comments: Infinite procedural generation avoids publication bias and label noise; useful complement to static benchmarks for targeting blind spots without large data distribution.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Procedurally-generated benchmarks reveal different failure modes than published-dataset benchmarks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: none exceed 45% accuracy; abstention and tool-mediated analysis major weaknesses

hf:2507.04227.task: Evaluating mobile GUI agents under real-world adversarial threats
hf:2507.04227.key_results: All agents significantly degraded by third-party content; misleading rates 42.0% (dynamic) and 36.1% (static); framework enables flexible, targeted app modifications
hf:2507.04227.comments: Pre-deployment validation reveals critical gap: benchmark performance doesn't reflect robustness to realistic noisy app content; important for safe real-world deployment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mobile GUI agents maintain performance on real apps with untrustworthy third-party content

nature:10.1038/s41392-026-02600-z.task: Review endoplasmic reticulum stress signaling in disease pathogenesis and therapeutic targeting opportunities
nature:10.1038/s41392-026-02600-z.key_results: Three UPR branches (IRE1, ATF6, PERK) regulate stress response and apoptosis; excessive activation drives cancer, cardiovascular, neurodegenerative, metabolic, and autoimmune diseases; ER stress modulation is promising therapeutic approach

nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03115-w.task: Clarify YAP/COX2 pathway role in neomycin-induced lipid droplet accumulation and hair cell damage

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71838-6.task: Determine molecular architecture of DISC1 protein and its multivalent binding capability

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72034-2.key_results: Ku80-Ct and 28-mer peptide Ku3 reduce MLLbcr breakage after doxorubicin; Ku3 antagonizes Ku80-EndoG association and modulates chromatin-binding of EndoG

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72150-z.key_results: G26R fibrils show untwisted unresolvable morphology; L90P and R173P fibrils display compact diabolo shape across all organs; cis-Proline 66 identified as potential conformational switch

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44134-y.task: Assess selective cytotoxicity and nanomechanical effects of nickel ferrite nanoparticles on cancer cells

nature:10.1038/s41556-026-01927-7.task: Review organellar roles in aging and longevity regulation

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46712-6.task: Assess platelet-rich plasma combined with post-conditioning for testicular ischemia/reperfusion protection

hf:2502.07408.task: Identifying and exploiting critical sign-bit vulnerabilities in neural networks

hf:2604.13074.task: Long-term personalized multimodal assistant with memory and reasoning

hf:2604.04936.task: Cost-efficient chunking strategy for web-based retrieval-augmented generation

hf:2604.15804.task: Omni-modal (audio, vision, text) understanding and generation at scale

hf:2604.18486.comments: Dual auxiliary decoders (language + world model) force richer latent representations than text-only supervision.
