hypotheses.result: Achieved with dual decoder supervision

hypotheses.hypothesis: World model prediction improves latent space quality over linguistic-only compression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enabled generalization

hf:2604.18292.task: Self-evolving training arena for general agent intelligence
hf:2604.18292.key_results: Agent-World-8B/14B outperforms proprietary models across 23 benchmarks; demonstrates scaling benefits with environment diversity
hf:2604.18292.comments: Autonomously synthesizes realistic task distributions from tool ecosystems, avoiding static benchmark saturation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scaling environments and self-evolution improves general agent capability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across 23 benchmarks

hf:2604.18394.key_results: GameCoder-27B with OpenGame framework achieves state-of-the-art on 150 game prompts; introduces verifiable game playability evaluation
hf:2604.18394.comments: Template and Debug Skills with living protocol of verified fixes address the hard problem of multi-file cross-consistency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Template and Debug skills enable stable game architecture generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduces integration errors vs. syntax-level patching

hf:2604.18564.key_results: MultiWorld outperforms baselines in video fidelity, action-following, and multi-view consistency; supports flexible agent/view scaling
hf:2604.18564.comments: Global State Encoder ensures coherent cross-view observations while Multi-Agent Condition Module enables precise multi-agent control.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit multi-agent and global state modules improve control and consistency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on game and manipulation tasks

hf:2604.16893.key_results: EasyVideoR1 achieves 1.47x throughput improvement; comprehensive task-aware reward system; outperforms single-modality RL on 22 benchmarks
hf:2604.16893.comments: Offline preprocessing and tensor caching eliminate redundant video decoding; mixed offline-online paradigm balances quality and exploration.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Video-specific optimizations improve RL training efficiency and quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 1.47x throughput with better accuracy

hf:2604.14258.task: Unified post-training via group fine-tuning with reward-like supervision
hf:2604.14258.key_results: GFT outperforms SFT baselines; achieves better integration with downstream RL; prevents entropy collapse and gradient explosion
hf:2604.14258.comments: Interprets SFT as sparse policy gradient, revealing pathological training dynamics that GFT addresses via group advantage learning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SFT suffers from sparse rewards and unstable inverse-probability weighting
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via training dynamics analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Group supervision and dynamic coefficient rectification stabilize learning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; better RL integration

hf:2604.18224.task: Multimodal web coding evaluation spanning generation, editing, repair
hf:2604.18224.key_results: WebCompass spans 7 task categories (text/image/video inputs × generation/editing/repair); reveals aesthetics as persistent bottleneck; framework choice materially affects performance
hf:2604.18224.comments: Agent-as-a-Judge via MCP-driven browser execution approximates human acceptance testing better than static metrics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Closed-source models substantially outperform open-source on web engineering
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across tasks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Repair task preserves interactivity better than other tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed but remains execution-challenging

hf:2604.17308.task: Lifelong skill discovery, repair, and evolution for autonomous agents
hf:2604.17308.key_results: SkillFlow shows +8.43pp improvement for Claude Opus; reveals gap between skill usage and utility; exposes failure modes in transfer and patching
hf:2604.17308.comments: Domain-Agnostic Execution Flow (DAEF) enables consistent lifelong learning protocol; high skill usage does not guarantee high utility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents can discover and evolve skills via lifelong learning
hypotheses.result: Yes, but with substantial capability gaps

hypotheses.hypothesis: High skill usage correlates with high utility
hypotheses.result: No; Kimi K2.5 shows 66.87% usage but only +0.60pp gain

hf:2604.16826.task: LoRA adapter merging via output-space interference calibration
hf:2604.16826.key_results: Pico improves accuracy by 3.4–8.3pp across 8 benchmarks; enables merged adapters to outperform task-agnostic multi-task LoRA
hf:2604.16826.comments: Key insight: B-matrix concentrates shared directions while A remains task-specific; downscaling over-shared B directions recovers performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Treating ΔW = BA as monolithic causes merge interference
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; B-matrix is primary culprit

hypotheses.hypothesis: Calibrating B via downscaling shared directions recovers performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; +3.4–8.3pp gains

hf:2604.18574.task: Learning to reason with weak supervision (scarce data, noisy rewards, self-supervised proxies)
hf:2604.18574.key_results: Reasoning faithfulness predicts generalization under weak supervision; SFT on reasoning traces necessary; continual pre-training amplifies effect
hf:2604.18574.comments: Training reward saturation dynamics govern generalization; memorization vs. learning determined by pre-saturation phase length.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reasoning faithfulness (logical support of final answer) predicts generalization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; output diversity uninformative

hypotheses.hypothesis: SFT on explicit traces + continual pre-training enable weak-supervision learning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Llama3.2-3B now generalizes

hf:2604.18543.task: Automatic environment generation for claw-like agents
hf:2604.18543.key_results: Auto-ClawEval comprises 1,040 environments at 13,800x lower cost than human curation; no model saturates benchmark; harness engineering boosts +15.7pp
hf:2604.18543.comments: Parser → Generator → Validator pipeline enables on-demand live evaluation and training environment synthesis from natural language.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Automated generation matches human curation on coherence/clarity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed at massive cost reduction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Harness engineering substantially impacts agent performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; up to +15.7pp over ReAct baseline

hf:2604.11102.task: Audio-visual script generation for long-form cinematic video
hf:2604.11102.key_results: OmniScript (8B) matches Gemini 3-Pro on temporal localization and multi-field accuracy despite 60% fewer parameters; RL with temporally segmented rewards drives improvement
hf:2604.11102.comments: Hierarchical scene-by-scene script generation with character actions, dialogues, expressions, audio cues; first long-form V2S benchmark.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chain-of-thought SFT improves plot and character reasoning
hypotheses.result: Yes; enables downstream RL

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporally segmented RL rewards improve script coherence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves state-of-the-art

hf:2604.18131.task: Spontaneous self-evolution via intrinsic world knowledge exploration
hf:2604.18131.key_results: +20% on WebVoyager/WebWalker; 14B Qwen3 outperforms unassisted Gemini-2.5-Flash via learned world knowledge; inference-time reward-free evolution
hf:2604.18131.comments: Outcome-based reward measures how self-generated world knowledge improves downstream task success; native evolution at inference requires no external guidance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents can learn intrinsic meta-evolution capability via outcome rewards
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; +20% improvement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned world knowledge transfers to unseen environments
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 14B Qwen3 beats Gemini-2.5-Flash

hf:2604.18584.task: Global multimodal multilingual mathematical reasoning and retrieval benchmark
hf:2604.18584.key_results: MathNet: 30,676 Olympiad problems across 47 countries, 17 languages; Gemini-3.1-Pro 78.4%, GPT-5 69.3%; retrieval-augmented generation gains up to 12%
hf:2604.18584.comments: Embedding models struggle at retrieval; RL-enhanced DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale achieves +12% via high-quality retrieval, validating retrieval quality sensitivity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Retrieval-augmented generation improves math reasoning
hypotheses.result: Yes; up to +12% with high-quality retrieval

hypotheses.hypothesis: Embedding models struggle at mathematical retrieval
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across modalities

hf:2604.17696.task: Learning transferable reasoning via trajectory-modulated game self-play
hf:2604.17696.key_results: STRATAGEM improves math reasoning; transfers across domains; stronger gains on competition-level mathematics where multi-step reasoning critical
hf:2604.17696.comments: Selectively reinforces abstract, domain-agnostic reasoning via Reasoning Transferability Coefficient; incentivizes adaptive reasoning via Evolution Reward.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain-agnostic reasoning patterns transfer across tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; stronger on math benchmarks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive reasoning development improves generalization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ablations support both components

hf:2604.16593.task: Semantic phrase processing and multiword expression evaluation
hf:2604.16593.key_results: SemanticQA consolidates MwE resources; reveals substantial performance variation on semantic reasoning tasks; identifies reasoning efficacy differences across architectures
hf:2604.16593.comments: Covers lexical collocations, idiomatic expressions, noun compounds, verbal constructions; sequential task composition tests deeper understanding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LMs show performance variation on semantic reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; highlights reasoning efficacy differences

hf:2604.13313.task: Compositional reasoning in vision-language models via concreteness-guided negative mining
hf:2604.13313.key_results: Slipform achieves state-of-the-art on compositional benchmarks, cross-modal retrieval, linear probing; resolves gradient imbalance via Cement loss
hf:2604.13313.comments: Lexical concreteness determines negative sample efficacy; margin-based loss dynamically calibrates pair penalization based on psycholinguistic scores.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modifying concrete terms generates stronger learning signal
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ConcretePlant isolates and manipulates perceptually grounded concepts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gradient imbalance restricts nuanced learning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Cement loss resolves via margin-based approach

hf:2604.08537.task: Cross-subject generalization in visual decoding from fMRI via meta in-context learning
hf:2604.08537.key_results: Achieves cross-subject visual decoding without fine-tuning via in-context learning; strong cross-scanner generalization; no anatomical alignment or stimulus overlap required
hf:2604.08537.comments: Meta-learned in-context inference inverts encoder per voxel then aggregates via hierarchical inference; enables truly generalizable brain decoding foundation model.

hypotheses.hypothesis: In-context learning of subject-specific encoding model enables cross-subject transfer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; no fine-tuning needed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical inference (voxel-level then aggregate) improves generalization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; strong cross-scanner results

hf:2604.18203.task: Multimodal exact arithmetic (multi-digit multiplication) across modalities
hf:2604.18203.key_results: Accuracy collapses as arithmetic load C > 100; C predicts performance across modalities (R² > 0.5); decomposition heuristic favored; multimodal degradation primarily computational not perceptual
hf:2604.18203.comments: Matched-perception analysis shows > 99% accuracy across modalities when perception isolated, confirming computation bottleneck.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Arithmetic load (product of total and non-zero digit count) predicts performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; R²=0.5-0.9

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multimodal degradation stems from perception
hypotheses.result: No; > 99% perception accuracy; computational bottleneck confirmed

hf:2604.17338.task: Precise debugging evaluation: measuring edit precision and bug recall
hf:2604.17338.key_results: Frontier models (GPT-5.1-Codex, DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking) achieve 76%+ pass rate but < 45% precision; iterative/agentic strategies fail to improve precision
hf:2604.17338.comments: Distinguishes true debugging from code regeneration via edit-level precision and bug-level recall metrics; reveals need for post-training rethinking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs can achieve high unit-test pass rates with minimal edits
hypotheses.result: No; precision < 45% despite > 76% pass rate

hypotheses.hypothesis: Iterative debugging improves precision
hypotheses.result: No; no substantial improvement

hf:2604.16902.task: Understanding modality preference in omni-modal LLMs
hf:2604.16902.key_results: Most OLLMs exhibit visual preference (paradigm shift from text-dominance); preference emerges progressively in mid-to-late layers; internal signals diagnose cross-modal hallucinations

hypotheses.hypothesis: OLLMs exhibit text-dominance like traditional VLMs
hypotheses.result: No; most show visual preference

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modality preference is static
hypotheses.result: No; emerges progressively in mid-to-late layers

hf:2604.06505.task: Biomedical conclusion generation from structured evidence
hf:2604.06505.key_results: MedConclusion: 5.7M PubMed structured abstracts; conclusion writing behaviorally distinct from summarization; strong models cluster under automatic metrics; judge identity substantially shifts scores
hf:2604.06505.comments: Naturally occurring supervision from author-written conclusions; journal-level metadata enables domain-stratified analysis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Conclusion writing is distinct from summarization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; different performance profiles

hypotheses.hypothesis: Automatic metrics distinguish strong models
hypotheses.result: No; strong models cluster closely; judge identity drives score variation

hf:2604.17972.key_results: Multi-strategy utterance generation outperforms single-strategy; RL-guided cognitive reasoning improves strategy selection; first evidence that multiple strategies per turn benefit dialogue
hf:2604.17972.comments: All-in-One and One-by-One decoding strategies; RL optimizes coherent multi-strategy composition beyond individual strategy quality.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multiple support strategies per utterance improve dialogue quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; first systematic evidence

hypotheses.hypothesis: RL-guided cognitive reasoning improves multi-strategy composition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; better strategy selection and response coherence

hf:2604.17698.task: Predicting steerability and detecting drift via representational stability
hf:2604.17698.key_results: Supervised geometric stability predicts steering (ρ=0.89–0.97); unsupervised stability detects drift (5.23× better than Procrustes); task alignment essential for controllability
hf:2604.17698.comments: Pairwise distance consistency measures both deployment readiness and post-training degradation; distinct metrics for pre- and post-deployment monitoring.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Geometric stability predicts linear steerability
hypotheses.result: Yes; ρ=0.89–0.97 with task alignment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Task-agnostic stability detects drift
hypotheses.result: Yes; 2× better change detection

hf:2604.17406.task: Foundational evolving agent framework for autonomous scientific discovery
hf:2604.17406.key_results: EvoMaster: state-of-the-art on 4 benchmarks (41.1% HLE, 75.8% MLE-Bench, 73.3% BrowseComp, 53.3% FrontierScience); +159–316% vs. OpenClaw; 100-line deployment
hf:2604.17406.comments: Domain-agnostic base harness with continuous self-evolution; SciMaster ecosystem spans ML, physics, general science; faithful to human scientific inquiry cycle.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-evolution mechanism improves scientific agent capability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; state-of-the-art across 4 benchmarks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain-agnostic framework generalizes across disciplines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ML, physics, general science

hf:2604.16943.task: Modality neuron-aware fine-tuning for image translation in MLLMs
hf:2604.16943.key_results: MNAFT outperforms instruction fine-tuning and parameter-efficient methods; identifies language-agnostic and language-specific neurons; selective fine-tuning preserves pre-trained knowledge
hf:2604.16943.comments: Instruction-driven activation analysis reveals specialized neuron roles; avoids parameter redundancy of full fine-tuning while closing visual-textual modality gap.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Specialized neurons mediate cross-modal understanding
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; language-specific and language-agnostic neurons identified

hypotheses.hypothesis: Selective fine-tuning outperforms full fine-tuning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; better generalization

hf:2604.16038.task: Time series anomaly detection via minimal denoising network
hf:2604.16038.key_results: JuRe ranks 2nd on TSB-AD (AUC-PR 0.404) and UCR (AUC-PR 0.198); no attention/latent/adversarial; training corruption most important (ΔAUC-PR 0.047)
hf:2604.16038.comments: Depthwise-separable residual block + parameter-free structural discrepancy scorer; manifold-projection principle sufficient; architectural complexity unnecessary.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Architectural complexity unnecessary for anomaly detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; minimal network achieves SOTA

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training-time corruption is dominant factor
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ΔAUC-PR 0.047 on removal

hf:2604.16642.task: Scene graph representation in hyperbolic space for hierarchical structure
hf:2604.16642.key_results: HSG improves graph-level metrics: PP IoU 33.17, Graph IoU 33.51 (vs. 25.37 AoMSG +8.14); maintains strong retrieval; hyperbolic geometry encodes hierarchy naturally
hf:2604.16642.comments: Hyperbolic distance naturally encodes hierarchical entailment; addresses Euclidean space limitation in capturing place-object hierarchies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hyperbolic geometry improves hierarchical structure quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; +8.14 Graph IoU gain

hf:2604.17886.task: Forecasting sparse, bursty vulnerability sightings under data constraints
hf:2604.17886.key_results: SARIMAX ill-suited to sparse vulnerability data; Poisson regression more stable/interpretable; exponential decay viable for short horizons
hf:2604.17886.comments: Discrete, event-driven nature requires count-based methods; discrete modeling outperforms continuous time-series approaches; practical guidance for cyber intelligence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Severity scores improve sighting forecasts
hypotheses.result: Limited improvement; insufficient for time-series methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Count-based models handle sparsity better
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Poisson more stable than SARIMAX

hf:2604.17388.task: Predicting regulatory architecture and cellular stress via geometric stability of CRISPR perturbations
hf:2604.17388.key_results: Shesha stability metric correlates with effect magnitude (ρ=0.75–0.97); master regulators show geometric tax (large, incoherent shifts); stability inversely associated with chaperone activation
hf:2604.17388.comments: Geometric instability reveals pleiotropic effects; complements magnitude for hit prioritization; stable/stable-stress quadrant systematically depleted.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Geometric coherence reflects regulatory specificity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; master regulators pay geometric tax

hypotheses.hypothesis: Geometric instability predicts cellular stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; inversely associated with HSPA5/BiP activation

hf:2604.17454.task: Personalized tool calling via latent preference modeling across sessions
hf:2604.17454.key_results: PRefine achieves better accuracy with 1.24% tokens vs. full-history prompting; handles Preference Recall/Induction/Transfer; evolving hypothesis refinement improves tool selection
hf:2604.17454.comments: Generate–verify–refine loop extracts reusable constraints; memory captures reasons for user choices, not just choices; enables personalization at inference time.

outputs: personalized tool calls with completed arguments

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent preference models enable accurate tool calling from underspecified inputs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PRefine improves accuracy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Memory of choice reasons enables better transfer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Preference Transfer challenge addressed

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71005-x.task: Map allosteric mutations and long-range energetic couplings across homologous PDZ domains
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71005-x.key_results: 21,802 free energy changes quantified (9,064 ∆∆Gf for fold stability, 12,738 ∆∆Gb for binding); conserved distance-dependent decay in mutation effects but protein-specific allosteric hotspots identified
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71005-x.comments: Comprehensive mutagenic dataset reveals both conserved energetic principles and divergent allosteric sites, suggesting family members may require distinct drug targeting strategies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Long-range energetic couplings are conserved across homologous proteins during evolution
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed: conserved distance-dependent decay observed, but each protein has distinct protein-specific allosteric mutations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Allosteric mutations cluster at conserved structural sites across the PDZ family
hypotheses.result: Rejected: allosteric hotspots diverge between family members, including in protein-specific domain extensions

nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03778-w.task: Identify SAMD4 as repressor of VGLL4 mRNA to activate YAP1/TAZ-TEAD oncogenic program
nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03778-w.key_results: SAMD4A/B destabilize VGLL4 mRNA to activate TEAD; transgenic SAMD4B mice develop intrahepatic cholangiocarcinomas by one week in Nf2-deficient background; SAMD4 inhibition elevates VGLL4 and suppresses TEAD
nature:10.1038/s41388-026-03778-w.comments: Genome-wide screening identified clinically actionable target; in vivo acceleration of tumorigenesis demonstrates potency, though SAMD4 selectivity among RNA-binding proteins requires clarification.

model_io.model: human cancer cells; transgenic liver-specific SAMD4B mice in Nf2-deficient background

hypotheses.hypothesis: SAMD4A/B repress VGLL4 mRNA to activate YAP1/TAZ-TEAD and promote cancer progression
hypotheses.result: SAMD4 inhibition elevates VGLL4, suppresses TEAD activity, inhibits cancer progression; liver-specific SAMD4B overexpression accelerates cholangiocarcinoma

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08750-w.task: Determine how TFAM regulates mitochondrial fission via Sirt3 interaction
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08750-w.key_results: TFAM promotes mitochondrial fission through direct Sirt3 interaction; activates AMPK/MFF/Drp1 pathway; high TFAM-SIRT3 co-expression correlates with survival in KIRC
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08750-w.comments: Multi-level validation (biochemistry, imaging, FRET, clinical data) is comprehensive; HMG-box A domain requirement provides structural basis for therapeutic targeting.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TFAM promotes mitochondrial fission through direct Sirt3 interaction and AMPK/MFF/Drp1 pathway activation
hypotheses.result: TFAM-Sirt3 interaction (mediated by HMG-box A) enhances Sirt3 stability, AMPK phosphorylation, and Drp1/MFF-dependent fission

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71873-3.task: Define distinct roles of PEX11 isoforms in peroxisomal intralumenal vesicle formation and size control
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71873-3.key_results: PEX11C/D/E promotes ILV formation, limits peroxisome size globally, required for efficient β-oxidation; PEX11A/B function during lipid mobilization; complete PEX11 loss is seedling-lethal
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71873-3.comments: Isoform-specific functional dissection extends PEX11 biology beyond canonical division roles; plant developmental relevance suggests conserved metabolic regulatory functions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distinct PEX11 isoforms have specialized roles in peroxisome biogenesis and metabolism
hypotheses.result: PEX11C/D/E globally promote ILV formation and size control; PEX11A/B function specifically during lipid mobilization

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71921-y.task: Characterize age-related oxidative inactivation of deubiquitylating enzymes and reversibility via antioxidant treatment
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71921-y.key_results: Subset of cysteine protease DUBs progressively lose activity with age via thiol oxidation despite stable protein abundance; N-acetylcysteine ethyl ester restores activity; DUB inhibition precedes proteasome decline
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71921-y.comments: Activity-based proteomics reveals oxidative post-translational modifications as early driver of proteostasis decline; reversibility suggests therapeutic opportunity in aging.

model_io.model: aging mouse and killifish brains; human iPSC-derived neurons

hypotheses.hypothesis: Oxidative stress impairs DUB activity with age, driving proteostasis decline and preceding proteasome dysfunction
hypotheses.result: Age-related DUB activity loss is reversible via antioxidant treatment and precedes proteasome decline in brain aging

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72228-8.task: Elucidate physiological roles of mitochondrial respiratory chain supercomplexes in metabolic flexibility
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72228-8.key_results: Tethered III2IV2 supercomplex supports robust respiration; selectively impacts NADH-driven respiration via distinct Nde1 interactions; substrate-specific respirasome-like SCs optimize electron flux
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72228-8.comments: Engineering approach isolating SC formation as a variable is elegant; metabolic flexibility mechanism suggests SC conformations serve regulatory rather than purely catalytic roles.

model_io.model: baker's yeast with engineered covalently-linked III2IV2 supercomplex

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distinct SC conformations optimize substrate-specific electron flux and metabolic flexibility
hypotheses.result: Tethered SC supports respiration but selectively impacts NADH-driven respiration through Nde1 interactions

nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03061-6.task: Develop NirFAP680, a bright near-infrared fluorogen-activating protein for advanced biological imaging
nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03061-6.key_results: NirFAP680 exhibits order-of-magnitude greater brightness and photostability than current NIR FAPs; >100 nm Stokes shift enables FRET/BRET applications; supports single- and two-photon live-cell and in vivo imaging
nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03061-6.comments: Engineering achievement providing valuable tool for biological imaging; large Stokes shift is unique advantage for multiparametric imaging and energy transfer applications.

model_io.model: NirFAP680 protein-fluorogen pair with HBMT fluorogen

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45680-1.task: Evaluate astaxanthin's therapeutic potential in chemically-induced hepatocellular carcinoma via Wnt/β-catenin inhibition
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45680-1.key_results: Combination therapy (ATX + doxorubicin) reduces ALT/AST/AFP by 45%/35%/49%; downregulates Wnt components (FZD-7, LRP5/6, β-catenin); mitigates chemotherapy-induced MDR1 upregulation
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45680-1.comments: Relevant preclinical model with mechanistic pathway validation; combination approach addresses both efficacy and resistance, though translational timeline to humans uncertain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Astaxanthin suppresses HCC progression by inhibiting Wnt/β-catenin signaling and reducing chemoresistance
hypotheses.result: Combination therapy downregulates FZD-7, LRP5/6, β-catenin; reduces cyclin D1; mitigates MDR1 upregulation versus doxorubicin alone

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49055-4.task: Develop protocol for high-yield isolation of microvascular niche cells from adult human skin
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49055-4.key_results: Simultaneous isolation of HDBECs, HDLECs, HDFs, and HDPCs from skin biopsies with high efficiency and purity; cells form vascular-like networks in 3D fibrin gels
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49055-4.comments: Methodological contribution enabling physiologically relevant vascular models; donor-matched approach supports aging and disease modeling.

outputs: HDPCs with verified CD31, PDPN, PROX1, CD49a expression

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49566-0.task: Assess omacetaxine mepesuccinate efficacy against osteosarcoma via c-Myc translation inhibition
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49566-0.key_results: OMX induces dose-dependent growth inhibition (IC50 nanomolar range) and apoptosis; reduces c-Myc protein and target transcripts; inhibits tumor growth and metastasis in orthotopic models
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49566-0.comments: Multi-species validation (canine, human, mouse) strengthens translational relevance, though c-Myc-driven dependency may limit broader applicability.

model_io.model: canine, human, mouse osteosarcoma cell lines and orthotopic xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: OMX reduces c-Myc translation to inhibit osteosarcoma growth and metastasis
hypotheses.result: OMX dose-dependently reduces c-Myc levels, induces apoptosis, and suppresses tumor progression in vivo

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49713-7.task: Map TLR4/NF-κB/TNF-α/MMP axis in sepsis-induced acute kidney injury and test dexamethasone intervention
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49713-7.key_results: TLR4/NF-κB/TNF-α axis drives MMP-9/MMP-3 expression and glycocalyx degradation; dexamethasone suppresses pathway, restores endothelial integrity, improves renal perfusion
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49713-7.comments: Comprehensive integration of transcriptomics with mechanistic validation is rigorous; dexamethasone's multi-level pathway suppression provides compelling therapeutic rationale.

model_io.model: bulk RNA-seq of septic mouse kidneys; human renal glomerular endothelial cells; murine sepsis models

hypotheses.hypothesis: TLR4/NF-κB/TNF-α axis drives glycocalyx degradation and microvascular failure in sepsis
hypotheses.result: Pathway activation increases MMP-9/MMP-3, degrades glycocalyx, disrupts ZO-1, increases permeability; dexamethasone reverses all changes

nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10090-6.task: Characterize crosstalk between MAPK Slt2 and IRE1-driven unfolded protein response
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10090-6.key_results: UPR operates in two phases: early IRE1-HAC1 splicing, later Slt2-Rlm1-dependent regulation; Slt2 promotes IRE1 expression
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10090-6.comments: The temporal dissection of UPR phases is insightful, though the specific conditions triggering phase transition remain incompletely defined.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Slt2 and Rlm1 regulate the later phase of UPR independent of early IRE1 signaling

hf:2604.19572.key_results: TACO reduces token overhead ~10% while improving TerminalBench performance by 1-4%; gains 2-3% under fixed token budget

hf:2604.20779.key_results: 6K sessions with 63K prompts; 44% agent code survives to commits; 44% of turns involve user pushback; bimodal patterns: 41% 'vibe coding', 23% human-only

hf:2604.20246.task: Plan-and-act visual reasoning for industrial robotic manipulation

hf:2604.20817.key_results: Transformers, RNNs, LSTMs, and embeddings converge on periodic features (T=2,5,10); Fourier sparsity is necessary but insufficient for geometric separability
hf:2604.20817.comments: Theoretical analysis is rigorous, but practical implications for model interpretability or design remain limited; focus on number representations may not generalize broadly.

hf:2604.18805.key_results: Evidence ignored in 68% of traces; refutation-driven revision in 26%; base model explains 41.4% of variance vs. 1.5% for scaffold; failures persist with trajectory context

hf:2604.16529.key_results: Claude-4.5-Opus: 70.9%→77.6% on SWE-Bench Verified; 46.9%→59.1% on Terminal-Bench v2.0; trajectory summaries enable selection and reuse

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72233-x.task: Elucidate EBF2 phase separation mechanisms in brown adipocyte thermogenesis

nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10085-3.key_results: Tubular mitochondria confine synthetic condensates to ~100 nm with minimal coarsening; bulbous mitochondria (Drp1K38A) permit rapid coalescence into single droplets

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08737-7.task: Elucidate how β-catenin/YAP heterogeneity promotes ovarian cancer metastasis
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08737-7.key_results: Mixed tumors with β-catenin heterogeneity showed synergistic metastatic enhancement; senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) in low-β-catenin cells promoted HM cell dissemination; senolytic agent and YAP inhibition reduced metastatic burden

nature:10.1038/s41556-026-01945-5.task: Understand lipid-driven mechanisms of caveolar formation and scission

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48952-y.task: Identify molecular targets and mechanisms of vitexin against precancerous gastric lesions

nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01248-5.task: Quantum error mitigation for fermionic simulation via subspace noise tailoring
nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01248-5.key_results: Subspace Noise Tailoring (SNT) combines low cost of Symmetry Verification with low bias of Probabilistic Error Cancellation; extends noisy device reach to larger system sizes and more Trotter steps compared to unmitigated baseline
nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01248-5.comments: The SNT approach elegantly balances cost and bias, though the paper primarily demonstrates feasibility for Fermi-Hubbard model rather than providing comparison with state-of-the-art classical algorithms.

model_io.model: Fermi-Hubbard model quantum simulation with QEM

hypotheses.hypothesis: Subspace noise tailoring via post-selection extends reach of noisy quantum computers for fermionic simulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: SNT extends to larger lattice sites and more Trotter steps; optimal QEM/encoding combinations identified

nature:10.1038/s41535-026-00884-6.task: Ground state magnetism of twisted WSe₂ at moiré hole filling
nature:10.1038/s41535-026-00884-6.key_results: Multi-Q magnetic order with four distinct wave vectors (three M-points plus one K-point) stabilized at experimentally relevant interaction strengths; coplanar and non-coplanar variants observed with softened spin fluctuations at M-points
nature:10.1038/s41535-026-00884-6.comments: Discovery of multi-Q states expands the magnetic phase diagram of moiré materials, but the paper does not discuss experimental signatures for verification or manipulation of these phases.

model_io.model: Twisted WSe₂ moiré system (3.65° twist angle)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-Q spin-valley order emerges as continuous deformation of 120° AFM in moiré WSe₂

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45722-8.task: Optoelectronic properties of quaternary oxychalcogenide LaCuTeO via first-principles
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45722-8.key_results: Direct bandgap 0.999 eV (LDA) or 1.324 eV (LDA+U); bulk modulus 108.33 GPa; optical absorption strong in visible-UV; refractive indices n_xx=3.253, n_zz=3.061; Vickers hardness 24.70 GPa
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-45722-8.comments: Comprehensive property calculations are thorough, but the material has not been experimentally synthesized or characterized, limiting assessment of practical applicability for photovoltaics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LaCuTeO quaternary oxychalcogenide exhibits favorable bandgap and optical properties for photovoltaic/photocatalytic applications

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47711-3.task: Stability of hydrodynamic bearings with nanofluid additives and variable axial geometry
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47711-3.key_results: TiO₂ nanofluid additives significantly improve critical stability number via aggregate size and packing effects; concave and wedge geometries outperform convex/wavy; modified Krieger-Dougherty model captures aggregation effects beyond static volume-fraction assumptions
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47711-3.comments: The integration of nanoparticle aggregation physics into bearing stability analysis is thorough, though practical optimization of trade-offs between aggregate size, packing, and stability remains under-explored.

model_io.model: Hydrodynamic journal bearing with TiO₂ nanofluid

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nanoparticle aggregation enhances bearing stability by modifying effective viscosity beyond volume-fraction models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: aggregation size and packing fraction strongly influence critical stability number; concave geometry optimal

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49116-8.task: Start-to-end simulation of laser-plasma-accelerated VHEE radiotherapy
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49116-8.key_results: Workflow models electron generation via PIC simulation, beam transport through quadrupoles/dipoles, and dose deposition in phantoms; demonstrates favorable dose distribution for deep tumor targeting using polychromatic VHEE beams
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49116-8.comments: Comprehensive pipeline from source to dose is valuable, though clinical feasibility depends on dose uniformity and gating that are not fully addressed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LPA-generated polychromatic VHEE beams can achieve conformal deep-tissue dose distributions competitive with conventional modalities
hypotheses.result: Supported by simulations showing favorable dose profiles through multifield setup

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49527-7.task: Microwave oscillator based on integrated plasmonic Si-ITO modulator
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49527-7.key_results: Phase noise of -62.84, -72.03, -82.32 dBc/Hz at 10 kHz offset for 43, 93, 193 m fiber delays at 8.251 GHz; modulator features ~1 μm active length and 40 GHz bandwidth
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49527-7.comments: Integration of plasmonic modulators on silicon is promising for miniaturization, but phase noise performance lags dedicated optoelectronic oscillators, limiting practical advantage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Plasmonic Si-ITO modulator can generate microwave oscillations with phase noise scaling with fiber delay length

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49942-w.task: Cooperation emergence in dynamic networks driven by Big Five personality traits
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49942-w.key_results: High initial cooperativeness plus history-sensitive reciprocity produces systems with higher prosperity, fairness, and safety; agreeableness helps when history matters but hurts when trait-driven; network degree assortativity near zero while agreeable agents preferentially connect
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49942-w.comments: The model elegantly translates behavioral personality dimensions into game-theoretic mechanisms; however, the purely computational nature limits validation against actual human behavior networks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cooperate-then-reciprocate strategy combined with endogenous network dynamics maximizes collective outcomes

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49981-3.task: Gamma-ray shielding properties of YBa₂Cu₃O₇/Bi₂O₃ composite materials
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49981-3.key_results: Linear attenuation coefficient (LAC) increases with Bi₂O₃ content; Bi20 sample achieves LAC of 0.5385 cm⁻¹ at 0.662 MeV; Monte Carlo predictions (GEANT4, MCNP) agree closely with experimental measurements
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49981-3.comments: Extensive Monte Carlo validation across multiple codes is rigorous; the work combines superconductor functionality with radiation shielding, though practical implementation constraints are not discussed.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50099-9.task: Broadband heterojunction photodetectors from transferred carbon nanowalls on silicon
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50099-9.key_results: CNW/n-Si photodetectors show responsivity 0.2 A W⁻¹, detectivity 3×10¹¹ Jones, detection range 300-1150 nm, NEP ~10⁻¹²–10⁻¹³ W Hz⁻¹/², temporal response 17/8 μs, cutoff frequency 53 kHz
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50099-9.comments: The broad spectral response and low noise are attractive for UV-NIR sensing, though responsivity is moderate compared to specialized photodetectors; scalability of CNW transfer to large areas is not addressed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vertically oriented CNWs transferred to Si substrate form rectifying heterojunctions with broadband photoresponse

nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02642-3.task: Quantum demodulation of electromagnetic signals using heteronuclear ions
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02642-3.key_results: Achieved inverse-quartic (t^-4) scaling for frequency estimation and inverse-quadratic (t^-2) scaling for amplitude estimation using reinforcement learning
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02642-3.comments: Reinforcement learning provides a practical approach to optimizing quantum control, though experimental implementation details on heteronuclear ion systems remain to be demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reinforcement learning can optimize quantum control to achieve better-than-classical scaling in parameter estimation

hf:2604.21915.task: Video reshooting from novel camera trajectories using 4D point clouds
hf:2604.21915.key_results: Improved 4D consistency and camera control compared to state-of-the-art baselines; generalizes to dynamic scene expansion and 4D scene recomposition

hypotheses.hypothesis: 4D-grounded point cloud representation with static segmentation preserves content appearance and camera control better than depth-based methods

hf:2604.17492.task: Improving diffusion-based image generation through adaptive semantic representation learning
hf:2604.17492.key_results: Faster convergence and higher sample quality compared to fixed representation joint diffusion models; prevents feature collapse through stop-gradient targets and regularization

hypotheses.result: Stable coevolution achieved with proposed combination of stabilization techniques preventing feature collapse

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72226-w.task: Determine cryo-EM structures of partially liganded kainate receptor hetero-tetramers to understand activation and desensitization
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72226-w.key_results: High-resolution pre-active state structures with asymmetric agonist binding reveal gating-associated interface reshaping, inter-dimer motions, and pore-linker repositioning; partial LBD interface disruption correlates with ligand occupancy state

nature:10.1038/s41389-026-00613-5.task: Determine vulnerability of cyclin E-overexpressing TNBC to CDC7 kinase inhibition and synergy with CDK8 inhibition
nature:10.1038/s41389-026-00613-5.key_results: Cyclin E overexpression enhanced CDC7 inhibitor sensitivity, reducing proliferation and colony formation; CCNE1 knockdown rescued growth; CRISPR screening identified CDK8 as conferring CDC7 inhibitor resistance; combined CDC7/CDK8 inhibition significantly reduced tumor growth in vivo

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08704-2.task: Determine if ASPP2 regulates cuproptosis via FDX1 and metabolic sensitization in hepatocellular carcinoma
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08704-2.key_results: ASPP2 promotes NR2F2 recruitment to FDX1 promoter, enhances mitochondrial OXPHOS/TCA cycle activity, and sensitizes HCC cells to cuproptosis; ASPP2-FDX1 co-expression in 90 HCC cases correlates with survival

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08760-8.task: Define nucleoporin TPR as MAPK-regulated component that modulates mitogenic transcriptional output
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08760-8.key_results: TPR is phosphorylated at Ser2155 by RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK MAPK cascade upon EGFR activation; TPR depletion reshapes EGF-induced gene expression, including enhanced FOS induction; CRISPR/Cas9 Tpr haploinsufficient mice show altered MAPK pathway regulatory gene expression

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46691-8.task: Evaluate combined mesenchymal stem cell and metformin therapy effects on pulmonary fibrosis using untargeted metabolomics
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46691-8.key_results: Combination therapy most effectively corrected metabolic disruptions and attenuated fibrosis; lung tissue sphingosine, 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid, cyclic GMP, and plasma corticosterone/phospholipids were key discriminatory metabolites

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47929-1.task: Examine adaptive responses of Dunaliella tertiolecta to zinc and copper toxicity under phosphorus limitation
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-47929-1.key_results: EC50 for both Zn2+ and Cu2+ ~15 mg/L; Cu2+ showed significantly higher toxicity than Zn2+; under phosphorus limitation, Cu2+ (25 mg/L) caused ~85% growth inhibition, 91% chlorophyll decline, and ~40% photosynthesis suppression; phosphorus availability reduced metal toxicity effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phosphorus deficiency exacerbates metal toxicity in algae; copper is more toxic than zinc under nutrient stress

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48498-z.task: Model premature hematopoietic aging in dyskeratosis congenita using non-local diffusion-advection dynamics
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48498-z.key_results: Lower initial proliferation potential (xH) and reduced telomerase activity accelerate stem cell exhaustion and pancytopenia onset (sometimes before age 2 years); two-year danazol treatment slowed telomere attrition and may improve oocyte preservation in female DC patients

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49053-6.task: Elucidate USP7-dependent FKBP4 stabilization in acquired osimertinib resistance through glycolytic remodeling
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49053-6.key_results: FKBP4 upregulation in osimertinib-resistant NSCLC promoted Warburg phenotype (increased GLUT1, LDHA, glucose uptake, lactate), activated PI3K-AKT signaling, and enhanced EMT; USP7 stabilized FKBP4 via deubiquitination; FKBP4 silencing restored osimertinib sensitivity in vivo

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49303-7.task: Characterize erythropoietin receptor signaling in melanocyte pigmentation and melanin production

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49493-0.task: Determine role of neuropeptide Y in vitiligo pathogenesis via NPY2R-mediated NF-κB activation

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49632-7.task: Identify TMEM115 as a novel tumor suppressor regulating TERT expression in pancreatic cancer

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49905-1.task: Characterize AZT transport, phosphorylation kinetics, and role of ABC transporters in Chinese population for personalized antiretroviral therapy

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50157-2.task: Assess miR-16-5p-mediated suppression of E2-induced cell proliferation and EMT in benign prostatic hyperplasia

model_io.model: Diffusion generative model with combinatorial stochastic processes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combinatorial stochastic processes fully exploit structural coverage better than existing schemes
hypotheses.result: Significantly accelerated network training across modalities

hypotheses.hypothesis: Asynchronous timesteps enable fine-grained control over different dimensions
hypotheses.result: New test-time generation mode allows varying degrees of control per dimension

hf:2605.02240.task: Evaluating LLM agents on long-horizon clinical workflows in EHR environments
hf:2605.02240.key_results: Best model achieves 46% pass rate; open-source models reach at most 19%; tasks require average 27 tool calls and reasoning over heterogeneous clinical information
hf:2605.02240.comments: First execution-grounded benchmark with real patient records and commercial EHR APIs; substantial gap between current agents and real clinical demands reflects fundamental reasoning and action sequencing challenges.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Long-horizon composite workflows require greater agent capabilities than single-step atomic actions
hypotheses.result: Current agents achieve only 46% max on realistic clinical tasks with 27 average tool calls

hypotheses.hypothesis: Execution-grounded verification reveals capability gaps missed by static benchmarks
hypotheses.result: Substantial performance drop from 46% (proprietary) to 19% (open-source)

hf:2605.02178.task: Stabilizing multi-turn reinforcement learning for reasoning LLMs via uncertainty-guided exploration
hf:2605.02178.key_results: T^2PO demonstrates substantial gains in training stability and performance improvements on WebShop, ALFWorld, and SearchQA with better exploration efficiency
hf:2605.02178.comments: Fine-grained exploration control at token and turn levels addresses real instability issues in RL-based LLM training; theoretical motivation linking instability to inefficient exploration is compelling.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Inefficient exploration at fine-grained levels causes training instability and collapse
hypotheses.result: T^2PO with token/turn-level control achieves substantial stability and performance gains

hypotheses.hypothesis: Uncertainty-aware thinking intervention prevents low-information action generation
hypotheses.result: Token-level monitoring and dynamic turn resampling reduces wasted rollouts

hf:2605.00529.task: Cross-document multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation via hierarchical abstract tree indexing
hf:2605.00529.key_results: Ψ-RAG outperforms RAPTOR by 25.9% and HippoRAG 2 by 7.4% in average F1 score on cross-document multi-hop QA benchmarks
hf:2605.00529.comments: Addresses critical limitations in tree-RAG scalability through adaptive distribution-aware clustering and cross-document connections; hierarchical abstract tree is practical innovation.

model_io.model: Hierarchical abstract tree index + multi-granular retrieval agent

hypotheses.hypothesis: Iterative merging-and-collapse adapts to data distributions better than k-means clustering
hypotheses.result: Ψ-RAG builds adaptive hierarchical indexes without a priori assumptions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit cross-document connections improve multi-hop retrieval
hypotheses.result: 25.9% F1 improvement over RAPTOR on cross-document benchmarks

hf:2605.02222.task: Flow matching for generative modeling of particle systems via orbit-space geometry
hf:2605.02222.key_results: Reduces metric error by up to two orders of magnitude on minimal surfaces; matches state-of-the-art on ShapeNet with 5x fewer steps and 26x fewer parameters vs DiT-3D
hf:2605.02222.comments: OGPP elegantly exploits permutation symmetries and physical geometry to simplify learning; orbit-space canonicalization and geometric probability paths are theoretically motivated innovations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orbit-space canonicalization reduces per-index target variance versus anonymous indexing
hypotheses.result: Significantly simpler, faster-to-learn flows compared to index-permutation approach

hypotheses.hypothesis: Geometric probability paths with terminal velocities encode normals naturally
hypotheses.result: Produces normals as byproduct of flow with competitive 3D reconstruction

hf:2605.02730.task: Visually grounded reasoning via perceptual flow networks with variational reinforcement learning
hf:2605.02730.key_results: Sets SOTA on V* Bench (90.6%) and MME-RealWorld-lite (67.0%) with provable performance guarantee
hf:2605.02730.comments: Decouples perception from reasoning via self-conditioned generation; avoids rigid expert geometric priors in favor of reasoning-oriented perceptual behaviors, addressing real hallucination issues in LVLMs.

model_io.model: Perceptual Flow Network (PFlowNet) with variational RL

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupling perception from reasoning enables better visual grounding than expert supervision
hypotheses.result: PFlowNet achieves SOTA on V* Bench and MME-RealWorld-lite

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-dimensional rewards with geometric shaping facilitate reasoning-oriented perception
hypotheses.result: Self-conditioned generation with variational RL preserves visual reliability

hf:2605.01725.task: Motion-aware caching for efficient autoregressive video generation
hf:2605.01725.key_results: MotionCache achieves 6.28x speedup on SkyReels-V2 and 1.64x on MAGI-1 while preserving quality (VBench: 1% and 0.01% degradation respectively)
hf:2605.01725.comments: Exploits inter-frame motion as proxy for pixel-level denoising requirements; coarse-to-fine strategy with motion-weighted cache reuse is practical and theoretically motivated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-motion pixels require more denoising steps; static pixels tolerate aggressive skipping
hypotheses.result: Motion-weighted cache reuse dynamically adjusts per-token update frequencies

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fine-grained pixel-level motion characteristics capture dynamics better than chunk-level skipping
hypotheses.result: 6.28x speedup achieved while maintaining quality

hf:2605.00932.task: Safety and capabilities assessment of Code World Model for pre-release evaluation
hf:2605.00932.key_results: CWM does not pose additional frontier risks beyond current AI ecosystem; cleared for open-weight release
hf:2605.00932.comments: Assessment conducted across catastrophic risk domains from Frontier AI Framework; limited public details on specific evaluation methodologies or quantitative findings.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Code generation and reasoning do not introduce frontier-level risks beyond existing models
hypotheses.result: Pre-release testing cleared CWM for open-weight release

hf:2604.25154.task: Learning data cleaning policies for tabular foundation models via prior alignment
hf:2604.25154.key_results: L2C2 achieves higher TabPFN accuracy on diverging cases (mean 0.851 vs 0.843); policy pre-trained on single source exceeds scratch training on held-out datasets (up to +28.8% improvement)
hf:2604.25154.comments: Frames data cleaning as RL problem over prior alignment; reveals that naive reward designs collapse to trivial strategies, highlighting need for principled reward engineering.

model_io.model: Deep RL agent (L2C2) with cleaning operators

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cleaning should minimize distributional gap to TFM synthetic prior rather than pursuing absolute data quality
hypotheses.result: TFMAwareReward reward design outperforms naive approaches on 4/10 datasets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cleaning knowledge transfers across datasets for TFM-specific alignment
hypotheses.result: Pre-trained policy on one source exceeds scratch training on all three held-out datasets

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72509-2.task: Determine how housefly visual system maintains accuracy during high-speed saccadic motion
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72509-2.key_results: Photoreceptor-LMC synapses sample ~2500 bits·s⁻¹ and transmit ~4100 bits·s⁻¹; synaptic high-frequency jumping extends bandwidth to ~1000 Hz; flies respond within ~13–20 ms, quadrupling flicker-fusion limits (~230 Hz)
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72509-2.comments: Remarkable findings on ultra-fast synaptic transmission, though the predictive mechanism invoked requires further validation beyond the biophysical model.

model_io.model: Intracellular and photomechanical recordings during saccade-like stimulation
inputs: visual stimuli with saccade-like motion profiles

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synaptic high-frequency jumping dynamically shifts transmission toward higher frequencies during saccades
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; extends visual bandwidth to ~1000 Hz and eliminates synaptic delays

hypotheses.hypothesis: Photomechanical-stochastic-refractory sampling co-adapts with saccadic behavior
hypotheses.result: Model reveals efficient translation of image motion into temporally-precise, predictive vision

nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10166-3.task: Elucidate molecular basis of ADP resistance in kinesin-3 KLP-6
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10166-3.key_results: KLP-6 shows KI/KM ratio of 44.9 vs. 1.3 for KIF1A; α2a helix region required for ATP/ADP selectivity; α2a helix is less stable in ADP-bound state
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10166-3.comments: Elegant structure-function study linking sequence variation to nucleotide selectivity through MD simulations, though direct structural validation of the ADP-bound state would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: α2a helix region confers ADP resistance
hypotheses.result: Swapping with KIF1A sequence abolished elevated ATP/ADP selectivity

hypotheses.hypothesis: α2a helix differential stability explains nucleotide selectivity
hypotheses.result: MD showed reduced conformational stability in ADP-bound vs. ATP-bound state

nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02654-z.task: Identify specificity-determining sites in two-component signaling systems
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02654-z.key_results: Two specificity-determining sites identified; cognate specificity reconfigurable by single mutations; mutational degeneracy maintains specificity while limiting crosstalk
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02654-z.comments: Combines computational screening (ProteinMPNN, AF3) with functional validation, though the mechanistic basis of epistatic effects could be deepened with structural dynamics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Energetic frustration marks specificity-determining sites
hypotheses.result: Two sites identified and validated by mutation and structural analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single mutations can reconfigure cognate specificity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; specificity is intrinsically marginal and tunable

nature:10.1038/s44456-026-00003-7.task: Review pH dynamics and regulation strategies in aqueous zinc-ion batteries
nature:10.1038/s44456-026-00003-7.key_results: pH fluctuations drive parasitic reactions and capacity fading; multiple regulation strategies identified: electrolyte engineering, electrode modification, interphase construction
nature:10.1038/s44456-026-00003-7.comments: A review paper summarizing mechanistic understanding rather than presenting novel experimental results; focus is on electrochemistry rather than molecular biophysics.

nature:10.1038/s41392-026-02732-2.task: Determine ENO2-driven immune crosstalk mechanism in colorectal cancer liver metastasis
nature:10.1038/s41392-026-02732-2.key_results: ENO2⁺ cancer cells enriched in CRLM patients; ENO2 binds MIF stabilizing it via blocking CHIP ubiquitination; ENO2-MIF interaction activates MIF signaling promoting M2 macrophage polarization; ENO2 knockout suppresses metastasis; pyrithioxin inhibitor reduces metastatic burden
nature:10.1038/s41392-026-02732-2.comments: Novel metabolic enzyme function in immune crosstalk; links glycolytic enzyme to immunosuppressive TME promoting dissemination.

model_io.model: CRC patient tissues, cancer cell lines, organoids, and syngeneic mouse models

hypotheses.hypothesis: ENO2 stabilizes MIF by blocking CHIP-mediated ubiquitination, promoting M2 macrophage polarization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ENO2 knockout reduced MIF stability and M2 polarization; pyrithioxin inhibitor suppressed metastasis in vivo

nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01744-3.task: Establish YPEL5 role in maintaining female fertility through folliculogenesis and oocyte maturation
nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01744-3.key_results: Ypel5 oocyte-specific knockout causes complete female infertility with accelerated primordial follicle depletion, defective antral follicle formation, impaired oocyte maturation; loss of Ypel5 increases DNA damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress triggering apoptosis; defective spindle organization and mitochondrial distribution
nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01744-3.comments: Identifies critical regulator of oocyte quality control; multiple cellular stress pathways converge on follicle depletion.

hypotheses.hypothesis: YPEL5 maintains follicle pool and oocyte quality by regulating mitochondrial homeostasis and DNA damage responses
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Ypel5 loss caused DNA damage accumulation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and oxidative stress-driven follicle depletion

nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01753-2.task: Elucidate LIN28A-PRC2 chromatin dynamics regulation during neuronal differentiation
nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01753-2.key_results: LIN28A upregulated during neural commitment with nuclear-to-cytoplasmic shift; Lin28a KO cells fail neuronal differentiation but maintain mesoderm/endoderm; LIN28A associates with PRC2; loss causes persistent PRC2 occupancy at developmental gene promoters with uncoupling from H3K27me3; NEAT1 lncRNA interaction may facilitate PRC2 eviction
nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01753-2.comments: Reveals post-transcriptional protein regulating chromatin remodeling independent of methylation deposition; demonstrates multi-layered epigenetic control.

model_io.model: ESCs and Lin28a knockout ESCs undergoing neural, mesodermal, endodermal differentiation

hypotheses.hypothesis: LIN28A regulates PRC2 eviction from chromatin during neuronal differentiation independent of H3K27me3 deposition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Lin28a KO caused persistent PRC2 binding with uncoupled H3K27me3; NEAT1 interaction identified as potential PRC2 eviction mechanism

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08799-7.task: Identify PELI1 as BCR-ABL1 stabilizer and target for TKI-resistant CML
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08799-7.key_results: BCR-ABL1 upregulates PELI1 via STAT5/FOXP3 pathway; PELI1 protects BCR-ABL1 from degradation; PELI1 inhibition suppresses TKI-sensitive and TKI-resistant CML cells and leukemia stem cells
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08799-7.comments: Addresses mechanisms of TKI resistance by targeting stabilization rather than direct kinase inhibition.

model_io.model: CML cell lines (TKI-sensitive and resistant) and LSCs

hypotheses.hypothesis: PELI1 protects BCR-ABL1 from proteasomal degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PELI1 inhibition causes BCR-ABL1 destabilization and suppresses proliferation in TKI-resistant cells

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08805-y.task: Explain neutrophil differentiation arrest in HAX1-deficient cells
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08805-y.key_results: HAX1 knockout cells show defective lipid droplet autophagy at lysosomal fusion stage and impaired fatty acid uptake; lipid droplet content increased with accumulated unmetabolized fatty acids
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08805-y.comments: Links autophagy dysfunction to metabolic failure in differentiation, providing mechanistic insight into Kostmann disease pathogenesis.

model_io.model: HAX1 wild-type and knockout promyelocytic cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: HAX1 deficiency impairs lipid droplet autophagy, blocking fatty acid metabolism necessary for differentiation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; defective lysosomal fusion and reduced free fatty acid generation observed

nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03121-y.task: Establish YWHAZ-HIF1A-LDHA axis in pulmonary arterial hypertension pathogenesis
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03121-y.key_results: YWHAZ silencing inhibits PAEC proliferation/migration and glycolysis; YWHAZ stabilizes HIF-1α which transactivates LDHA; HIF-1α agonist reverses knockdown effects; improves RV function and reduces pulmonary remodeling in vivo
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03121-y.comments: Targets metabolic dysregulation as therapeutic approach in PAH; metabolic intervention may complement current therapies.

model_io.model: Hypoxia-induced PAECs and hypoxia/SU5416-induced PAH rat model

hypotheses.hypothesis: YWHAZ stabilizes HIF-1α to upregulate LDHA-driven glycolysis in PAH
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; YWHAZ silencing reduced HIF-1α and LDHA; HIF-1α agonist rescue validated pathway

nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03139-2.task: Determine PBX1 role in colorectal cancer and therapeutic targeting strategy
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03139-2.key_results: PBX1 downregulated in CRC; overexpression inhibits proliferation/invasion but suppresses apoptosis via BCL2L1-Bcl-xL axis; BCL2L1 knockdown restores apoptosis and enhances 5-FU sensitivity in vivo
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03139-2.comments: Reveals dual regulatory role of PBX1 where anti-growth and pro-survival functions can be uncoupled therapeutically.

model_io.model: CRC cell lines and xenograft tumors

hypotheses.hypothesis: PBX1 transcriptionally activates BCL2L1 to promote apoptotic resistance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CUT&RUN showed PBX1 binding to BCL2L1 promoter; BCL2L1 knockdown reversed anti-apoptotic effects

nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03145-4.task: Identify ZNF473-p53-Survivin axis in colorectal cancer progression and chemoresistance
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03145-4.key_results: ZNF473 highly expressed in CRC correlating with poor prognosis; ZNF473 knockdown inhibits viability/proliferation; ZNF473 binds p53 promoting degradation upregulating Survivin; associated with Cytochrome P450 drug metabolism pathways
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03145-4.comments: Links transcriptional regulation of p53 degradation to chemotherapy resistance; provides novel therapeutic target.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ZNF473 destabilizes p53 to upregulate Survivin and promote chemoresistance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ZNF473 knockdown increased p53 and reduced Survivin; associated with chemotherapy sensitivity

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71205-5.task: Resolve hierarchical collagen assembly pathway and structural basis of metastability
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71205-5.key_results: Time-resolved cryo-EM identified metastable triple-helical intermediate as fundamental assembly unit; F-Z-F rules govern assembly; α2a helix conformational lability propagates through cascade; intermediates lacking D-band retain biological activity
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71205-5.comments: Mechanistic insights into ECM assembly may explain vulnerability to environmental perturbations and aging-related matrix dysfunction.

model_io.model: Purified collagen in vitro assembly with time-resolved cryo-EM

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metastable triple helix serves as assembly unit enabling hierarchical organization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cryo-EM resolved intermediates showing progressive structural stabilization through assembly cascade

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72319-6.task: Elucidate non-canonical BRD4 function in X-linked Dystonia-Parkinsonism mRNA processing
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72319-6.key_results: BRD4 depletion rescues XDP molecular signature independent of coactivator function; XDP-SVA induces premature TAF1 cleavage/polyadenylation; BRD4 depletion bypasses termination checkpoint; reveals BRD4 role in mRNA processing independent of H3K27ac
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72319-6.comments: Identifies unexpected mRNA processing function of BRD4; suggests therapeutic potential of modulating splicing/polyadenylation rather than transcription.

model_io.model: XDP patient-derived neurons and XDP cell models with BRD4 knockdown

hypotheses.hypothesis: BRD4 depletion bypasses SVA-induced premature cleavage/polyadenylation in TAF1
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; BRD4 knockout rescued XDP signature independent of H3K27ac; effect independent of coactivator function

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72395-8.task: Determine SIRT3-DsbA-L-TFAM axis role in preventing cGAS-driven metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72395-8.key_results: SIRT3 deacetylates DsbA-L (Lys165/167/177) enabling TFAM interaction for mitochondrial integrity; SIRT3/DsbA-L knockout causes mtDNA release, cGAS activation, and MASH; cGAS knockout or DsbA-L overexpression reverses MASH
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72395-8.comments: Identifies mitochondrial quality control axis as central to preventing pathogenic innate immune activation in metabolic disease.

model_io.model: Hepatocyte-specific knockout mice (SIRT3, DsbA-L, cGAS) with HFD

hypotheses.hypothesis: SIRT3-mediated DsbA-L deacetylation preserves mitochondrial integrity to prevent cGAS activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SIRT3 knockout caused mtDNA release and cGAS-dependent MASH; counteracted by cGAS deletion

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72791-0.task: Elucidate metabolic-immune link between hypoglycemia and influenza susceptibility
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72791-0.key_results: Hypoglycemic mice show reduced lung TRIM5 expression and increased IAV susceptibility; AMPK activation suppresses ERK1/2-AP-1 axis to reduce Trim5 transcription; TRIM5 deficiency impairs type I interferon response
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72791-0.comments: Establishes mechanistic connection between metabolic stress and innate antiviral defense through AMPK-ERK-AP-1-TRIM5 signaling.

model_io.model: Mouse models with intermittent hypoglycemia and IAV infection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypoglycemic stress suppresses TRIM5 expression via AMPK-ERK1/2-AP-1 pathway
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pathway inhibitor studies validated sequential signaling; TRIM5 knockout increased IAV susceptibility

nature:10.1038/s41477-026-02293-w.task: Map spatial metabolic gene regulation in chili pepper fruit development
nature:10.1038/s41477-026-02293-w.key_results: Single-nucleus atlas of 332,468 cells across 57 pepper samples; identified layer-specific transcription factors (WRKY6, ZAT10, BTF3) correlating with capsanthin accumulation; established multilayered metabolic compartmentalization
nature:10.1038/s41477-026-02293-w.comments: Comprehensive spatial transcriptomics resource; demonstrates how developmental patterning transcription factors orchestrate specialized metabolism.

model_io.model: Single-nucleus RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics of Capsicum annuum fruit

hypotheses.hypothesis: Layer-specific transcription factors regulate spatial partitioning of specialized metabolite biosynthesis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; WRKY6, ZAT10, BTF3 expression correlates with laminar capsanthin accumulation patterns

nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03082-1.task: Develop deep learning computational multiplexing for fluorescence microscopy unmixing
nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03082-1.key_results: MicroSplit separates up to 4 superimposed noisy structures into denoised channels; Variational Splitting Encoder-Decoder networks provide uncertainty quantification via posterior distributions; enables faster, photon-efficient multi-target imaging
nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03082-1.comments: Addresses fundamental imaging trade-offs; uncertainty estimation valuable for biological interpretation and experimental planning.

model_io.model: Variational Splitting Encoder-Decoder neural network architecture
inputs: single-channel fluorescence image with superimposed structures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning can computationally unmix multiplexed fluorescence data while providing uncertainty estimates
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MicroSplit successfully separated up to 4 structures across diverse datasets and noise conditions

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50507-0.task: Determine SOX9-mediated transcriptional repression of galectin-3 in chondrocytes
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50507-0.key_results: Proximal LGALS3 promoter (-97 to +52 bp) critical for activity; SOX9 binds promoter region (-93/+49) and dose-dependently represses LGALS3 expression; modest reduction in endogenous LGALS3 mRNA with SOX9 overexpression
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50507-0.comments: Identifies SOX9 as negative regulator of galectin-3; relevant for OA pathogenesis where SOX9 dysfunction and Gal-3 upregulation both occur.

model_io.model: SW1353 chondrosarcoma cells with SOX9 overexpression and LGALS3 promoter variants

hypotheses.hypothesis: SOX9 binds LGALS3 proximal promoter to suppress transcription
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ChIP-seq validated SOX9 binding; dose-dependent LGALS3 repression with SOX9 overexpression

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51953-6.task: Characterize clopidogrel bisulfate effects on endothelial progenitor cell function under oxidative stress
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51953-6.key_results: Clopidogrel (5-10 µM) increased EPC metabolic activity without basal apoptosis induction; under H2O2 stress, reduced Bax/Bcl-2 ratio and increased p-ERK; suggests context-dependent survival signaling
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51953-6.comments: Reveals potential vascular repair benefits of clopidogrel beyond antiplatelet effects; oxidative stress-dependent activation is clinically relevant.

model_io.model: Human peripheral blood EPCs treated ± clopidogrel bisulfate ± H2O2

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clopidogrel modulates EPC survival signaling specifically under oxidative stress via ERK pathway
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; no basal changes in apoptosis/ERK; oxidative stress revealed reduced Bax/Bcl-2 and increased p-ERK

nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10155-6.task: Elucidate S100A6-mediated mechanisms of T. gondii dissemination and brain cyst formation
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10155-6.key_results: T. gondii infection upregulates S100A6 via calcium-P65 signaling; S100A6-filamin A interaction promotes cytoskeletal reorganization and cell migration; S100A6 knockout mice show reduced BBB permeability, decreased tachyzoite brain entry, and fewer brain cysts
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10155-6.comments: Identifies host protein hijacking mechanism enabling parasite dissemination; suggests potential therapeutic intervention point.

model_io.model: T. gondii-infected cells and C57BL/6 mice; S100A6 knockout mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: T. gondii upregulates S100A6 to enhance host cell migration facilitating parasite dissemination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; S100A6 knockout impaired migration, reduced BBB crossing, and decreased brain cyst formation

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72198-x.task: Foundation model for single-cell RNA-seq representation learning
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72198-x.key_results: RegFormer outperforms scGPT, Geneformer, scFoundation, scBERT on clustering, batch integration, and cell-type annotation; trained on 25M cells across 45 tissues
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72198-x.comments: Integrating GRNs with Mamba architecture is elegant, though computational complexity and training cost details are not provided in abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GRN-guided gene ordering and dual embeddings improve representation learning
hypotheses.result: Superior performance vs existing foundation models across benchmarks

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72388-7.task: Map ligand-target activity across spatial tissue niches
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72388-7.key_results: Renoir identifies niche-specific ligand-target interactions, spatially maps pathway activities, resolves cell-cell interactions in development and disease (fetal liver, HCC)
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72388-7.comments: Addresses gap in spatial transcriptomics methods; resolution-agnostic (spot to single-cell) design is valuable; biological validation via known interactions (hepatocyte-macrophage).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial topology constrains ligand-target relationships within distinct cellular niches
hypotheses.result: Identified niche-specific interactions; resolved known hepatocyte-macrophage and onco-fetal interactions

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72667-3.task: Knowledge preservation strategies in big science and AI era
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72667-3.key_results: Perspective identifies need for alternative dissemination, documentation standards, sustainable infrastructure; proposes moderated platforms and AI-powered implementation tools
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72667-3.comments: Important meta-science perspective addressing reproducibility and knowledge loss; calls for systemic change in scientific culture and funding models.

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72708-x.task: Improve atrial fibrillation risk prediction via ancestry-optimized multi-trait polygenic scores
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72708-x.key_results: Multi-trait approach improves prediction in South-Asian (OR/SD 1.5-1.8, AUC 0.60-0.64, R² +71%), Admixed-American (1.5, 0.60, +34%), African (1.4, 0.57, +56%); best in European/East-Asian (1.8-2.2, 0.65-0.68)
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72708-x.comments: Addresses critical equity issue in polygenic risk scores; ancestry-specific optimization substantially improves non-European performance, though disparities remain.

inputs: genome-wide SNP data (All of Us, BioBank Japan, cohorts)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ancestry-optimized multi-trait polygenic scores improve AF risk prediction across diverse populations
hypotheses.result: Significant improvements in non-European ancestries; 71% relative R² gain in South-Asian; persistent performance gap vs European ancestry

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72816-8.task: Characterize sex-associated differences in CAR T-cell therapy toxicities
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72816-8.key_results: Females show higher ROR for CRS (1.10; 95% CI 1.00-1.20) and leukemias (1.34; 1.05-1.70); sex-associated patterns distinct from baseline cancer therapy differences; heterogeneity by cancer type/product
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72816-8.comments: Pharmacovigilance mining of FAERS reveals clinically actionable sex differences; warrants mechanistic investigation and prospective sex-stratified toxicity management studies.

inputs: adverse event reports (n=7700 CAR T cases)

hypotheses.hypothesis: CAR T-cell therapy toxicities exhibit sex-specific patterns
hypotheses.result: Females elevated ROR for CRS and leukemias; multi-organ system differences; heterogeneity by cancer type/product

nature:10.1038/s41597-026-07283-3.task: Assemble and annotate chromosome-level reference genome of Tristram's Bunting
nature:10.1038/s41597-026-07283-3.key_results: HiFi+Hi-C assembly: 1.33 Gb, 22.42 Mb contig N50, 64.94 Mb scaffold N50; 17,401 genes annotated; 99.3% BUSCO completeness
nature:10.1038/s41597-026-07283-3.comments: High-quality reference enables comparative passerine genomics; assembly metrics are excellent and suitable for evolutionary/comparative studies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromosome-level assembly enables investigation of rapid radiation in Emberiza
hypotheses.result: High-quality reference (99.3% BUSCO) generated; 32% repetitive sequences identified

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48680-3.task: Topology-preserving conjunctival vessel segmentation and tortuosity analysis for diabetes assessment
