hf:2605.04012.task: Conversational AI for patient symptom assessment and differential diagnosis
hf:2605.04012.key_results: SymptomAI differential diagnosis 2.47× more accurate than clinician baseline (p<0.001); dedicated symptom interview significantly outperforms user-guided (p<0.001); validated on 13,917 real-world conversations
hf:2605.04012.comments: Real-world deployment with ground truth from 1,228 clinician diagnoses is valuable, but reliance on self-reported diagnoses for remaining 12,689 participants limits confidence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dedicated symptom interview elicits more diagnostic information than user-guided conversation
hypotheses.result: Agentic interview strategy substantially outperforms baseline; results generalize to US population panel

hf:2605.02801.task: RL optimization of multi-agent system orchestration traces
hf:2605.02801.key_results: Survey of 84 papers identifying 8 reward families, 8 credit-bearing units, 5 orchestration sub-decisions; no explicit RL training for stopping decision found
hf:2605.02801.comments: Comprehensive systematization of multi-agent RL, but scale gap between academic methods and industrial deployment (Kimi, OpenAI, Anthropic) remains unresolved.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orchestration RL requires explicit modeling of spawn, delegate, communicate, aggregate, stop decisions
hypotheses.result: Curated pool reveals missing stopping-decision training and credit-assignment sparsity

hf:2605.03941.task: Benchmarking world models on interaction and memory tasks
hf:2605.03941.key_results: 330k video clips, 2.1k curated samples, 4.9k test samples; Action Generation Framework unifies evaluation across 14 world models; identifies key limitations in perception and memory
hf:2605.03941.comments: iWorld-Bench provides valuable unification of world model evaluation, but the discrepancy between curated (2.1k) and total dataset size (330k) suggests potential bias.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified Action Generation Framework reveals critical limitations in world model interaction capabilities
hypotheses.result: 6 task types assess visual generation, trajectory following, and memory; leaderboard tracks progress

hf:2605.03073.task: Indic ASR for entity-dense domain-specific speech
hf:2605.03073.key_results: Telugu EHR 0.473 (17× over SOTA, 3× over commercial on entity-dense test); Tamil 0.543 (22× over baselines); <$50 TTS synthesis cost for 22k utterances
hf:2605.03073.comments: TTS-STT flywheel addresses real-world underrepresentation, but cross-language variability and honest reporting of unmet EHR targets underscore domain-specific challenges.

model_io.model: Indic TTS pipeline + LoRA fine-tuned Whisper

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic entity-dense training data closes Indic ASR gap in specialized domains
hypotheses.result: LoRA fine-tune on EDSA corpus achieves 17× improvement; transfer to real speech validated (EHR 0.516)

hf:2605.01717.task: Thread-constrained discourse-aware modeling for conversational sentiment analysis
hf:2605.01717.key_results: State-of-the-art on two benchmark datasets using TC-DAG and D-RoPE; alleviates Distance Dilution and structural noise from GCN baselines
hf:2605.01717.comments: TC-DAG and D-RoPE provide novel position encoding for dialogue, but quantitative improvements over baselines are not explicitly stated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Thread-constrained DAG and discourse-aware rotary embeddings capture dialogue structure better than GCN+RoPE
hypotheses.result: State-of-the-art on DiaASQ benchmarks; alleviates Distance Dilution problem

hf:2605.01371.task: Agentic UAV embodied search and rescue in realistic environments
hf:2605.01371.key_results: 600 real-world rescue case tasks; four high-fidelity photorealistic environments from GIS data; identifies bottlenecks in spatial memory, aerial adaptation, and safety tradeoffs
hf:2605.01371.comments: ESARBench's photorealistic UE5/AirSim environments and GIS integration are impressive, but evaluation baselines are mostly traditional methods rather than state-of-the-art MLLM agents.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MLLM-driven UAV agents struggle with spatial memory, aerial adaptation, and safety in realistic embodied rescue scenarios
hypotheses.result: Baselines reveal critical bottlenecks; search efficiency-safety tradeoff identified

hf:2605.01466.task: Point cloud completion via Gaussian splatting and cross-modal attention
hf:2605.01466.key_results: State-of-the-art on PCN and ShapeNet-55/34; maintains robust visual dependency on KITTI stress test; avoids Cross-Modal Entropy Collapse
hf:2605.01466.comments: SplAttN's reformulation of projection as continuous density estimation is principled, and counter-factual evaluation rigorously validates cross-modal dependence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gaussian splatting avoids sparse support collapse and improves cross-modal connection learnability
hypotheses.result: State-of-the-art on PCN/ShapeNet; maintains visual robustness on KITTI despite multimodal reliance

hf:2605.02943.task: Multi-turn agentic RL for clinical reasoning across medical domains
hf:2605.02943.key_results: TT-OPD achieves best on 10/18 benchmarks with +3.9pp improvement; controls response length, maintains multi-turn tool use, faster convergence
hf:2605.02943.comments: Healthcare AI GYM with 3.6K+ tasks and 135 domain-specific tools is comprehensive, but vanilla GRPO's instability and length explosion reveal fundamental challenges in clinical RL.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Turn-level truncated on-policy distillation improves clinical RL training stability and efficiency
hypotheses.result: TT-OPD best on 10/18 benchmarks; faster convergence with sustained multi-turn tool use

hf:2605.02904.task: Lossless compression via online Mamba SSM and sparse n-gram context
hf:2605.02904.key_results: 2.123 bpb on 1MB enwik8 (8.7% vs xz -9e), 2.149 bpb on 3MB (5.4% vs xz), 2.162 bpb on 10MB (0.7% vs xz); ~2000 tokens/sec on x86-64
hf:2605.02904.comments: StateSMix couples SSM with sparse n-gram hash tables in elegant fashion; SSM alone accounts for 46.6% compression gain, with n-gram providing 4.1% complementary gain.

model_io.model: Mamba SSM (DM=32, NL=2, 120K params) + 9 sparse n-gram tables

hypotheses.hypothesis: Online-trained SSM with entropy-adaptive n-gram mixing outperforms LZMA2
hypotheses.result: StateSMix 8.7% better on 1MB, 5.4% on 3MB, 0.7% on 10MB enwik8

hf:2605.01284.task: Pixel-level visual attribution for iterative retrieval-augmented generation
hf:2605.01284.key_results: Fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct outperforms text-based baselines on Wiki-CoE and SlideVQA; bounding-box attribution eliminates parsing, preserves visual layout reasoning
hf:2605.01284.comments: CoE's retriever-agnostic approach and pixel-level attribution are valuable for interpretability, but evaluation is limited to two domain-specific benchmarks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vision-language models reasoning on screenshots preserve spatial logic better than text-based iRAG
hypotheses.result: Qwen3-VL outperforms text baselines on layout-dependent tasks (SlideVQA, Wiki-CoE)

hf:2604.27488.task: Automated skill optimization and self-evolution for LLM agents
hf:2604.27488.key_results: Skills-Coach framework with 4 core modules; Skill-X benchmark of 48 diverse skills; significant performance improvements across wide skill categories
hf:2604.27488.comments: Skills-Coach addresses skill fragmentation via automated testing and optimization, but specific performance metrics and comparison baselines are not provided.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Automated skill optimization explores capability boundaries and improves competency coverage
hypotheses.result: Skills-Coach achieves significant improvements across skill categories; enables comprehensive coverage for agents

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72778-x.task: Determine structure and druggable conformation of homodimeric LolDF transporter
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72778-x.key_results: Resolved cryo-EM structures of LolDF in apo-closed, vanadate-trapped closed, and inhibitor-bound open conformations; revealed stepwise abaucin-induced opening mechanism creating induced-fit binding pocket
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72778-x.comments: This work elegantly connects structural dynamics to drug mechanism, though the functional validation of abaucin selectivity across bacterial species remains to be fully demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LolDF undergoes conformational cycling between apo-closed and nucleotide-bound states analogous to E. coli LolCDE
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via structures capturing multiple conformational states with distinct nucleotide binding geometry

hypotheses.hypothesis: Abaucin inhibits LolDF through stepwise opening mechanism rather than simple competitive inhibition
hypotheses.result: Multiple abaucin molecules induce stepwise conformational changes to establish induced-fit pocket

nature:10.1038/s41416-026-03451-9.task: Identify NUDT21-mediated alternative polyadenylation of oncogenes in colorectal cancer
nature:10.1038/s41416-026-03451-9.key_results: Abstract incomplete; NUDT21 implicated in alternative polyadenylation-driven oncogene regulation affecting CRC malignancy and metastasis
nature:10.1038/s41416-026-03451-9.comments: Insufficient abstract detail prevents comprehensive assessment of specific findings, mechanisms, or quantitative outcomes.

nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01749-y.task: Modulate ZBP1-mediated microglial PANoptosis and secondary TBI neuroinflammation via USP4 inhibition
nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01749-y.key_results: USP4 deubiquitinates and stabilizes ZBP1 in microglia; heme and TNF-α synergistically induce ZBP1-mediated PANoptosis post-TBI; Vialinin A-mediated USP4 inhibition reduced microglial PANoptosis, ameliorated TBI-related cognitive deficits, and inversely correlated with severe TBI patient prognosis
nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01749-y.comments: The identification of USP4 as a ZBP1 stabilizer in the context of TBI-induced neuroinflammation is novel; however, the relative contributions of PANoptosis inhibition versus broader USP4 substrate depletion to cognitive recovery merit deeper mechanistic validation.

model_io.model: Microglial cells, murine TBI models, and patient TBI cohorts

hypotheses.hypothesis: USP4 stabilizes ZBP1 through deubiquitination, promoting PANoptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: USP4 interacts with and deubiquitinates ZBP1; USP4 inhibition triggers ZBP1 degradation

hypotheses.hypothesis: USP4 inhibition reduces microglial PANoptosis and improves TBI outcomes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Vialinin A reduced PANoptosis and ameliorated cognitive deficits; USP4 negatively correlated with severe TBI prognosis

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08603-6.task: Elucidate proteasomal CHK1 degradation mechanism in ALS-linked protein aggregation
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08603-6.key_results: FUS and TDP-43 cytoplasmic inclusions trigger proteasomal CHK1 and ASF1A downregulation; CHK1 restoration via overexpression or proteasome inhibition reduces DNA damage accumulation; CHK1 downregulation confirmed in patient-derived neurons and FUS-ALS mouse spinal cord
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08603-6.comments: The mechanistic link between protein aggregates and proteasomal targeting of a DNA repair checkpoint kinase is compelling; however, whether direct proteasomal degradation requires specific ubiquitin ligase adapters remains incompletely characterized.

model_io.model: Neuronal cell lines, patient-derived motor neuron progenitors, and FUS-ALS mouse spinal cord

hypotheses.hypothesis: TDP-43 and FUS cytoplasmic inclusions trigger proteasomal CHK1 degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: proteasome inhibition restored CHK1 and ASF1A levels in cells with FUS/TDP-43 inclusions

hypotheses.hypothesis: CHK1 restoration reduces DNA damage in ALS cellular models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: transient CHK1 and ASF1A overexpression reduced DNA damage signal accumulation

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08836-5.task: Overcome pan-RAF-MEK inhibitor resistance in non-BRAF-mutant melanomas via mTOR inhibition
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08836-5.key_results: Sapanisertib + belvarafenib + cobimetinib suppressed ATF4 and MTHFD2 expression, induced DNA damage, and sensitized resistant NRAS/NF1/KIT-mutant melanoma cells; ATF4-MTHFD2 axis required for drug resistance escape
nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08836-5.comments: Mechanistic elegance linking an epigenetic/translational control pathway (ATF4) to DNA repair capacity is notable, though in vivo efficacy data in patient-derived models would strengthen clinical translational claims.

model_io.model: NRAS/NF1/KIT-mutant melanoma cell lines and patient-derived xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: mTOR inhibition suppresses ATF4-MTHFD2-mediated DNA repair, enhancing RAF-MEK inhibitor efficacy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ATF4 and MTHFD2 downregulation coincided with increased DNA damage and improved drug response in resistant models

nature:10.1038/s41525-026-00576-x.task: Review mechanistic links between tubulin variants and ciliary dysfunction
nature:10.1038/s41525-026-00576-x.key_results: Tubulin gene variants disrupt microtubule-dependent ciliogenesis, axoneme formation, and intraflagellar transport, directly connecting tubulinopathies and ciliopathies as overlapping disease mechanisms
nature:10.1038/s41525-026-00576-x.comments: This is a review article synthesizing existing evidence rather than presenting novel experimental data, useful for conceptual framing but lacking new quantitative findings.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44696-x.task: Establish porcine minor salivary gland anatomy and histochemistry as baseline for translational salivary gland research
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44696-x.key_results: Porcine minor salivary glands exhibit mucous, serous, or mixed acini with serous demilunes; histochemistry revealed acidic sulfated mucosubstances, sialomucins, glycogen, and protein in mucous units; acinar and luminal diameters of mucous acini significantly exceeded serous acini; interlobular duct diameter significantly larger than intercalated and striated ducts (p<0.01 and p<0.05)
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-44696-x.comments: This is a purely descriptive morphological and histochemical baseline study in a non-disease model; its value lies in validating the pig as a translational model for human salivary gland pathology rather than advancing mechanistic understanding of salivary gland biology.

model_io.model: Porcine minor salivary glands from adult healthy pigs
inputs: tissue samples from oral mucosa propria-submucosa

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48139-5.task: Enhance photodynamic therapy efficacy via small extracellular vesicle-mediated hypericin delivery
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48139-5.key_results: sEV–HYP + PDT reduced IC₅₀ from 12.9 to 9.8 µg/mL (24 h) and 8.9 to 5.1 µg/mL (48 h); accelerated intracellular HYP deposition (91.0% vs. 68.0% at 4 h); enhanced ROS generation 3.85-fold vs. 3.10-fold and apoptosis to 45.3% vs. 41.8%
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48139-5.comments: Strong correlation between ROS and apoptosis (r=0.992) and coordinated epigenetic remodeling provide mechanistic depth, though causality between miRNA shifts and PDT efficacy remains to be formally tested.

model_io.model: AGS gastric cancer cells with sEV–HYP delivery and 590 nm PDT

hypotheses.hypothesis: sEV delivery accelerates intracellular HYP deposition relative to free drug
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 91% vs. 68% HYP+ cells at 4 h; 0.63 vs. 0.36 µg/mg protein by HPLC

hypotheses.hypothesis: Enhanced ROS generation drives apoptosis in sEV–HYP + PDT
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: strong correlation r=0.992, p<0.001

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51149-y.task: Inhibit integrin α2β1-dependent metastatic migration via cryptic collagen epitope targeting
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51149-y.key_results: mAb D93 targeting D93 cryptic collagen epitope reduced MDA-MB-231 and MCF10CA1a (M4) spheroid migration into collagen type I hydrogels; cell-line-specific differential effects on migration (pronounced in M4) vs. collagen remodeling (pronounced in MDA-MB-231); two-photon microscopy confirmed mAb D93-driven alterations in collagen fiber and fibril architecture
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51149-y.comments: Cell-line-dependent heterogeneity in response is pragmatically important for therapeutic development but complicates mechanistic interpretation without molecular profiling of integrin or collagen-binding protein expression across models.

model_io.model: 3D spheroids (MDA-MB-231 and MCF10CA1a) in collagen type I hydrogels
inputs: monoclonal antibody D93 targeting cryptic collagen epitope
outputs: collagen fiber and fibril architecture (two-photon microscopy)

hypotheses.hypothesis: mAb D93 blocks integrin α2β1-mediated collagen binding and cellular migration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: reduced migration into collagen with likely α2β1 involvement; cell-line-specific effect magnitudes

hypotheses.hypothesis: mAb D93 alters collagen architecture at fiber and fibril levels
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: two-photon microscopy revealed remodeling, with differential impact across cell lines

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72740-x.task: Neuromorphic in-memory biosignal processing using memristor arrays for edge audio recognition
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72740-x.key_results: 100% accuracy on 10-class audio signals with 1.44 fJ per denoising operation; >90% class-specific accuracy under noise after 15 training epochs
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72740-x.comments: Impressive energy efficiency and integrated denoising-recognition architecture, though the evaluation is limited to synthetic or controlled audio datasets and scalability to real-world acoustic complexity requires demonstration.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Partitioned volatile-nonvolatile memristor regions enable concurrent denoising and high-precision classification with femtojoule efficiency
hypotheses.result: Achieved 100% accuracy post-denoising with 1.44 fJ/operation and >90% accuracy under noise, outperforming non-denoised approaches

nature:10.1038/s41531-026-01345-4.task: Classification of individual Parkinson's disease cases using MEG-derived neural oscillatory features
nature:10.1038/s41531-026-01345-4.key_results: Optimal AUC–ROC of 0.87±0.04 for PD classification; significant increases in theta (p=0.0001) and decreases in gamma spectral power (p=0.0001)
nature:10.1038/s41531-026-01345-4.comments: Robust single-case classification achieved, but the relative clinical utility compared to existing diagnostic criteria and the mechanistic interpretation of dissociable oscillatory components remain unclear.

model_io.model: Contrast of Parameter Estimates with permutation testing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Oscillopathies (theta slowing, gamma dysregulation) characterize PD at the individual level

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50872-w.task: Chaos-enhanced optimization for medical data classification
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50872-w.key_results: Best average rank of 1.16 in Friedman test (p=0.0012); consistent improvements across six medical datasets including breast cancer and thyroid data
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50872-w.comments: Addresses premature convergence in optimization-based classifiers, though clinical validation remains pending and the practical advantage over simpler methods on heterogeneous data is not quantified.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chaotic dynamics mitigate premature convergence in cluster-based classification
hypotheses.result: Achieved best overall performance with statistically significant improvements confirmed by Friedman test

nature:10.1038/s41698-026-01458-2.task: Radiogenomic integration for tumor microenvironment assessment from breast MRI
nature:10.1038/s41698-026-01458-2.key_results: CAF proportion prediction accuracy of 0.87; >0.8 average accuracy in five multicenter validations for radiomic subtyping; revealed inverse CAF-T-cell relationship in TNBC
nature:10.1038/s41698-026-01458-2.comments: Novel non-invasive TME profiling approach, though reliance on deconvolution accuracy and limited mechanistic insight into discovered biomarker-phenotype associations warrant further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Inverse relationship exists between CAFs and T-cell infiltration in TNBC
hypotheses.result: Relationship revealed through customized deconvolution outperforming baselines

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51692-8.task: Construct solitary wave solutions to time-fractional (3+1)-dimensional Painlevé-type equation
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51692-8.key_results: Obtained closed-form solutions in trigonometric, rational, and hyperbolic functions; identified bright and dark solitary wave profiles via Katugampola time-fractional derivative framework
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51692-8.comments: Application of generalized expansion methods to fractional PDEs is standard; novelty lies primarily in the specific equation and visualization of fractional derivative effects rather than methodological innovation.

3D and 2D wave profiles (bright and dark solitons)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Katugampola fractional derivative captures qualitatively different dynamics compared to standard derivatives
hypotheses.result: Supported; fractional parameter variations demonstrated via visual comparisons in wave profiles

nature:10.1038/s41377-026-02276-8.task: Metal-ion-doped inorganic UV phosphors: persistent, upconversion, and mechanoluminescence modes
nature:10.1038/s41377-026-02276-8.key_results: Comprehensive review of persistent, upconversion, and mechanoluminescent UV materials; rare-earth and heavy main-group dopants enable tunable UV emission; material design principles for optimizing brightness, lifetime, and photostability established
nature:10.1038/s41377-026-02276-8.comments: Systematic review synthesizing mechanistic insights across three UV luminescence modes; applications in optoelectronics, environmental remediation, and biomedicine identified but not experimentally integrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Systematic material design based on luminescence mechanism (persistent, upconversion, mechanoluminescence) optimizes UV emission performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via review: performance-driven application strategy enables material selection for specific use cases

nature:10.1038/s41377-026-02280-y.task: Active steering of cathodoluminescence via generalized Smith-Purcell effect with tunable metasurfaces
nature:10.1038/s41377-026-02280-y.key_results: Generalized Smith-Purcell effect in finite periodic arrays enables programmable electron-driven light generation (THz-to-visible); doped graphene and phase-change materials provide active tunability; comparison shows advantages over passive gold/silver plasmonic structures
nature:10.1038/s41377-026-02280-y.comments: Novel electron-photon interface combining rigorous theory with active material platforms; experimental demonstration absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Individually tunable metasurface elements enable active control of Smith-Purcell radiation direction and spectrum
hypotheses.result: Confirmed theoretically: amplitude and phase control yields programmable electron-driven light sources across THz-visible

nature:10.1038/s41378-026-01297-y.task: Noise suppression in optically pumped magnetometers via liquid crystal polarization grating
nature:10.1038/s41378-026-01297-y.key_results: LCPG achieves 95% first-order diffraction efficiency at 795 nm with 44.6° ellipticity; differential power configuration suppresses pump-power noise; 4 cm³ probe achieves 8.6 fT/Hz^(1/2) sensitivity (~28% improvement vs. conventional OPM)
nature:10.1038/s41378-026-01297-y.comments: Elegant planar integration replacing multiple bulk optical elements; cost-effective high-throughput manufacturing pathway established.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LCPG multifunctional design (polarization conversion + beam splitting) reduces noise sensitivity in OPMs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: differential configuration achieves 28% sensitivity improvement over conventional single-beam design

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72722-z.task: Remote vibration-triggered disassembly of modular electronics-free structures
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72722-z.key_results: Single vibration source enables selective disassembly of cuboctahedral modular units; external vibration reduces effective friction coefficient enabling remote trigger; surrogate model maps connector geometry to disassembly properties for inverse design
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72722-z.comments: Elegant mechanics-based approach eliminates need for embedded electronics; scalability to large 3D structures and robustness to environmental variability merit further study.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mechanical waves reduce inter-connector friction enabling remote selective disassembly
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: external vibration lowers effective friction, enabling staged/underwater/load-bearing disassembly scenarios

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72773-2.task: Time-synthetic optical neural networks with stable programmable gain for deep photonic intelligence
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72773-2.key_results: Programmable gain integrated into time-synthetic ONN architecture enables stable loss compensation and extended network depth; causal temporal topology suppresses backward channels preventing gain-induced instabilities; robust image classification performance demonstrated
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72773-2.comments: Overcomes fundamental stability limitation of spatial photonic meshes; practical scalability to truly deep networks (10+ layers) remains challenging.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed: forward temporal evolution eliminates backward channels, allowing robust loss compensation and network depth extension

nature:10.1038/s41524-026-02082-1.task: Automated meta-optimization of Wannier functions for entangled band structures
nature:10.1038/s41524-026-02082-1.key_results: Thousand-fold acceleration of Boltzmann transport from minimal Brillouin zone grids; millielectronvolt-accuracy bandgap interpolation; personal-computer-accessible calculations previously requiring supercomputers
nature:10.1038/s41524-026-02082-1.comments: Transformative workflow combining differential evolution and Bayesian optimization; limited to weakly entangled systems.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed: automated pipeline achieves millielectronvolt accuracy and 1000× speedup

nature:10.1038/s41528-026-00582-0.task: Mechanically morphable plasma actuators (M-DBD) with liquid metal electrodes for deployable applications
nature:10.1038/s41528-026-00582-0.key_results: Stable atmospheric plasma discharge under biaxial stretch, crumpling, and origami folding; power dissipation scales predictably with strain; compact foldable design enables space-limited deployment
nature:10.1038/s41528-026-00582-0.comments: Novel soft robotics/space application direction for DBD; long-term durability quantification and efficiency metrics incomplete.

nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01250-x.task: Photonic simulation of vibronic spectra: bridging chemistry and Gaussian boson sampling
nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01250-x.key_results: Linear coupling approximation (coherent state sampling) outperforms GBS for formic acid; identified molecular attributes determining when full GBS is unnecessary; improved GBS-chemistry connection established
nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01250-x.comments: Important foundational mapping of chemistry approximations to photonic implementations; limited molecular set tested.

nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01251-w.task: Large-scale quantum reservoir computing using frequency-multiplexed Gaussian boson sampler (>400 modes)
nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01251-w.key_results: Access to mode correlations improves accuracy >20 percentage points vs. mean photon number alone; squeezed light consistently yields highest accuracies; GBS effective quantum reservoir at very large system sizes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Squeezed light improves GBS-based quantum reservoir computing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: squeezed light consistently produces highest accuracies vs. classical light sources

nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01262-7.task: Multiuser entanglement distribution across cryogenic quantum network nodes via integrated photonics
nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01262-7.key_results: Five-user fully-connected network with ten entangled photon pairs; all measured raw visibilities exceed classical limit; silicon integrated photonics + superconducting nanowire detectors enable cryogenic deployment
nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01262-7.comments: First demonstration of heterogeneously integrated photonic chips for cryogenic quantum networks; scalability beyond five users and network distance not addressed.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46832-z.task: Design of Mn/Fe-doped CsGeCl₃ perovskite for flexible solar cells

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-52335-8.comments: Novel persistent homology approach provides unified structural–functional framework, though mechanistic validation of TAD-loop interplay in diverse genomic contexts would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TAD boundaries and chromatin loops form functionally integrated multiscale structures that regulate gene expression
hypotheses.result: Spatial proximity to TAD boundaries modulated differential expression probability; multiscale structures predicted expression changes in inside and truncated genes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Persistent homology captures hierarchical chromatin organization better than existing TAD/loop callers
hypotheses.result: topoHiC outperformed benchmarks on both TAD and loop detection

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51033-9.task: Parameterized quantum random number generation on NISQ devices
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51033-9.key_results: PQC-H-CH architecture achieves 126 fully passing NIST SP 800-22 test configurations (vs 110 and 69 for alternatives); preprocessing choices more influential than NIST parameter tuning
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51033-9.comments: Systematic NISQ characterization is valuable; however, limited to simulation and no hardware validation; practical RNG quality remains contingent on device-specific noise profiles.

model_io.model: Parameterized quantum random number generators (PQC-H-CH, H-PQC-CH, H-CH-PQC)
outputs: NIST SP 800-22 test results (15 statistical tests)

hypotheses.hypothesis: PQC architectures with optimal preprocessing improve QRNG randomness quality on NISQ platforms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: PQC-H-CH passes 126 configurations with preprocessing more impactful than NIST parameter adjustment

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53357-y.key_results: MLP achieves best performance (80.0% accuracy, 0.825 AUC) while SGD Logistic Regression reaches 77.5% accuracy with 0.815 AUC; privacy maintained via HashCode-based security abstraction
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53357-y.comments: Addresses privacy-by-design effectively but lacks comparison with other privacy-preserving methods or privacy-utility trade-off analysis; dataset details are sparse.

model_io.model: Multiple classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, MLP)
outputs: classification metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1, AUC)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep models (MLP) outperform traditional methods on non-linear churn patterns while preserving privacy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: MLP achieves 80.0% accuracy vs 77.5% for Logistic Regression with balanced precision/recall

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53783-y.task: Illicit Bitcoin transaction detection in temporal graphs
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53783-y.key_results: FG-EGCN achieves strong performance on Elliptic dataset with improved temporal stability and robustness under distribution shift; produces more compact, separated embedding space for illicit nodes
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53783-y.comments: Addresses realistic temporal graph challenges (class imbalance, evolving structure) but evaluation limited to single dataset; temporal distribution shift evaluation is valuable for practical deployment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining temporal encoding, feature preservation, and adaptive gating improves illicit detection under imbalanced labels
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via ablation studies showing contribution of each component; focal loss improves sensitivity to rare illicit samples

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model produces more interpretable embeddings than baselines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via representation visualization showing illicit nodes form compact clusters well-separated from majority class

hf:2605.15298.task: Robot learning from human egocentric video and physical commonsense
hf:2605.15298.key_results: SOTA on ERQA, PhysBench, SimplerEnv-WidowX, LIBERO, RoboCasa; strong out-of-domain performance on SimplerEnv
hf:2605.15298.comments: Converting human video into structured QA supervision is a practical bridge from perception to embodied control, though scalability to diverse robot morphologies remains open.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physical commonsense from human video transfers to robot control
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via SOTA results across multiple benchmarks

hf:2605.13527.task: Multimodal skill learning and reuse for visual agents
hf:2605.13527.key_results: Consistent improvement over frontier and smaller multimodal agents on GUI and game benchmarks; compact state-conditioned skill packages
hf:2605.13527.comments: Factorizing procedural knowledge into text, state cards, and keyframes is elegant, though evaluation on truly novel domains would strengthen claims.

model_io.model: Trajectory-to-Skill Generator + Branch-loaded Multimodal Skill Agent

hypotheses.hypothesis: External multimodal procedural knowledge complements model-internal priors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across benchmarks

hf:2605.12882.task: Evaluating evidence attribution in document VQA
hf:2605.12882.key_results: Strict Attributed Accuracy (SAA) of 76.0% for strongest MLLM (Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview), 22.5% for best open-source; reveals attribution hallucination
hf:2605.12882.comments: Attribution correctness is crucial for high-stakes applications; the 53.5pp gap between top models highlights a significant reliability issue masked by answer-only metrics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Models can produce correct answers while citing wrong regions (attribution hallucination)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across 20 MLLMs

hf:2605.15824.key_results: 23.8 FPS on single GPU, 30-180× faster than baselines; supports interactive multi-garment switching with motion coherence
hf:2605.15824.comments: Using single-garment data via in-context learning is clever; the training-free KV cache rescheduling avoids retraining for new garments.

model_io.model: Autoregressive video generation with streaming distillation

hypotheses.hypothesis: In-context learning on reference-garment mismatch preserves motion coherence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; model implicitly learns to switch garments while maintaining motion

hf:2605.16257.key_results: 11 functionally grounded tasks; 1.1K trajectories collected; identifies key limitations in current policies for tool-use and bimanual coordination
hf:2605.16257.comments: Well-motivated benchmark filling gap between parallel grippers and dexterous hands; insights on multi-task learning and action-head adaptation are valuable.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain randomization and multi-task training improve dexterous manipulation robustness
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; specific policy limitations identified across settings

hf:2605.14333.task: Improving text and face fidelity in discrete tokenization for image generation
hf:2605.14333.key_results: InsightTok with 16k codebook and 16× downsampling significantly outperforms prior tokenizers on text and face reconstruction without harming general quality
hf:2605.14333.comments: Content-aware perceptual losses for text/faces are well-motivated; the compact codebook and downsampling rate are competitive against prior work.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Localized, content-aware perceptual losses improve text and face fidelity over generic reconstruction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; gains transfer to downstream generation

hf:2605.11739.task: Understanding and accelerating on-policy distillation for LLMs
hf:2605.11739.key_results: EffOPD achieves 3× training acceleration while maintaining comparable final performance; identifies module-level and update-direction mechanisms
hf:2605.11739.comments: The parameter-dynamics perspective is insightful; however, generalization to other distillation paradigms and larger models could be explored.

model_io.model: Large Language Model with gradient tracking

hypotheses.hypothesis: OPD establishes stable update trajectory early, concentrating updates on critical modules
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; lower-rank concentration observed

hf:2605.02290.task: Distilling long-chain-of-thought reasoning through multi-teacher collaboration
hf:2605.02290.key_results: CoRD achieves near teacher-level student performance with fewer supervision signals; generalizes to out-of-domain and open-ended settings
hf:2605.02290.comments: Step-wise reasoning synthesis with perplexity-based scoring elegantly captures teacher collaboration; beam search preserves diverse hypotheses efficiently.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heterogeneous teachers can jointly construct coherent reasoning via step-wise collaboration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; higher-quality data with reduced redundancy

hf:2605.15980.task: Efficient alignment of video diffusion models via one-step policy optimization
hf:2605.15980.key_results: Flash-GRPO outperforms full trajectory training in alignment quality under low compute budgets; 14B models validated
hf:2605.15980.comments: Iso-temporal grouping and temporal gradient rectification elegantly address timestep-confounded variance; stability gains are significant.

model_io.model: Video diffusion model with GRPO alignment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-step training can match or exceed full trajectory GRPO if timestep variance is controlled
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; iso-temporal grouping and gradient rectification essential

hf:2605.15726.task: Structured exploration for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards
hf:2605.15726.key_results: NudgeRL outperforms standard GRPO with 8× larger rollout budgets; outperforms oracle-guided baselines on five math benchmarks
hf:2605.15726.comments: Strategy nudging via lightweight context induction is elegant; the unified objective decomposing inter/intra-context rewards is well-motivated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured exploration with strategy contexts is more efficient than brute-force rollout scaling or oracle-guided methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across five math benchmarks

hf:2605.15256.task: Steering NPC behavior in reactive game world models
hf:2605.15256.key_results: Zero-shot strategy transfer to unannotated games; robust prompt-aligned NPC strategy adherence; fine-grained player controllability maintained
hf:2605.15256.comments: Decoupling player controls from NPC behaviors via additive bias and cross-attention is principled; game-agnostic representation enables transfer.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Game-agnostic interactive logic can transfer zero-shot to unannotated games
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on two Street Fighter games

hf:2605.12058.task: Generalizing policy optimization via Hölder mean aggregation
hf:2605.12058.key_results: HölderPO achieves 54.9% average accuracy on math benchmarks (7.2% gain over GRPO), 93.8% on ALFWorld
hf:2605.12058.comments: The Hölder mean unification of token-level aggregation is mathematically elegant; dynamic annealing resolves the concentration-stability trade-off.

model_io.model: Large Language Model with Hölder mean policy optimization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larger p concentrates gradients while smaller p bounds variance; dynamic annealing balances both
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior stability and convergence

hf:2605.15301.key_results: State-of-the-art among code-generation agents; nearly doubles single-pass baseline accuracy across CodeContests, APPS, and live Codeforces
hf:2605.15301.comments: Four-agent closed-loop with trainable graph-structured knowledge networks elegantly accumulate experience; the feedback-as-RL-updates design is novel.

model_io.model: Multi-agent system (Planner, Solver, Oracle, Hacker) with knowledge networks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stateful agentic evolution with targeted hacking and outcome-driven updates outperforms static multi-agent pipelines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across multiple benchmarks

hf:2605.15597.task: Sparse panoramic RGB-D-pose dataset curation for 3D learning
hf:2605.15597.key_results: 36,373 curated ERP frames from 1,275 indoor scenes; median 25 frames/scene covering 13 room types; COVER improves coverage-conflict trade-off
hf:2605.15597.comments: Training-free ERP viewpoint curation is practical; the geometry-aware evaluation methodology and provenance logging set a standard for dataset construction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Greedy coverage-style curation preserves complete scene coverage with low redundancy under bounded proxy error
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; median 25 frames sufficient

hf:2605.15963.task: Point-precise geometric GUI control with topology-aware planning
hf:2605.15963.key_results: 4.1× higher task success than strongest baseline; 62% step success (vs. <9% for GUI-specialized agents); closes Semantic-Execution Gap
hf:2605.15963.comments: The precision-sensitive regime is well-motivated and underexplored; dependency-structured planning with pixel-level RL is a principled solution.

hypotheses.hypothesis: General multimodal models exhibit high action-type accuracy but low task success on precision-sensitive tasks (Semantic-Execution Gap)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 88% action accuracy vs. <6% task success

hf:2605.15876.task: Dense metric depth estimation in vision-language models
hf:2605.15876.key_results: DepthVLM generates full-resolution depth maps alongside text outputs; outperforms existing VLMs with higher inference efficiency; surpasses leading pure vision models
hf:2605.15876.comments: Lightweight depth head attached to LLM backbone is elegant; unified vision-text supervision paradigm enables native geometry prediction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: VLMs can learn dense geometry through unified vision-text supervision without external distillation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior to VLMs with external geometry models

hf:2605.15181.task: Open-ended multi-step image editing via planning and reinforcement learning
hf:2605.15181.key_results: Experiential learning with reward-driven execution outperforms single-step and rule-based multistep baselines; coherent and reliable edits
hf:2605.15181.comments: Coupling planning with outcome-based rewards is elegant; vision-language judge provides meaningful supervision signal for complex editing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tight coupling between planning and reward-driven execution improves coherence for multi-step editing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms decoupled baselines

hf:2605.15320.task: Generalizable feed-forward 3D avatar reconstruction from few-shot images
hf:2605.15320.key_results: 5.5 PSNR gain over LAM on NeRSemble; real-time reconstruction (2s without personalization, 10s with); 49 FPS animation on A100
hf:2605.15320.comments: Three-stage curriculum (pretraining→fine-tuning→personalization) is well-motivated; elimination of offline FLAME extraction improves efficiency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-view fusion with end-to-end FLAME prediction generalizes better than offline extraction approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; substantial improvements on benchmarks

hf:2605.15843.task: Converting static 3D worlds into editable and interaction-ready scenes
hf:2605.15843.key_results: Enables object-level editing and collision-aware manipulation; preserves global scene coherence; supports embodied task execution
hf:2605.15843.comments: Multimodal agent guidance for decomposition, reconstruction, and inpainting is practical; the approach bridges generative scene synthesis and interactive simulation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multimodal agents can guide conversion of monolithic scenes to interaction-ready object-centric representations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; richer interaction scenarios enabled

hf:2605.15871.task: LLM agents autonomously designing neural architectures
hf:2605.15871.key_results: AIRAformer-D and AIRAhybrid-D improve accuracy 2.4% and 3.8% over Llama 3.2; AIRAformer-C scales 54-71% faster; matches human SOTA on LRA
hf:2605.15871.comments: Dual-framework (high-level search + low-level implementation) is comprehensive; multi-agent exploration under fixed budget shows LLMs can discover competitive architectures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM agents can autonomously discover architectures matching or exceeding hand-designed baselines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; competitive results across scales

hf:2605.14539.task: Learning from failed trajectories via correction-oriented policy optimization
hf:2605.14539.key_results: CIPO consistently outperforms RLVR baselines across 11 benchmarks; stronger pass@K gains; improves both reasoning and correction performance
hf:2605.14539.comments: Repurposing failed trajectories as correction supervision is elegant and effective; joint optimization of RLVR and correction objectives is well-motivated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Failed trajectories contain useful correction signals that improve reasoning when jointly optimized with RLVR
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across benchmarks

hf:2605.08614.key_results: 6,690 expert-validated MCQAs; frontier models (claude-opus-4.6) reach ~51% vs. 45% human baseline; all models show brittleness under perturbation
hf:2605.08614.comments: The symbolic-to-MCQA pipeline and perturbation variants expose failure modes (distractor brittleness, pattern-matching); calibration rather than capability is the bottleneck.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs struggle with specialist domain knowledge but brittleness under structural perturbation suggests pattern-matching rather than robust reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 13-60% accuracy loss under distractor expansion

hf:2605.05945.task: Facilitating long-horizon egocentric data collection on mobile hardware
hf:2605.05945.key_results: 200 hours of diverse egocentric data collected; persistent state tracking; enables hour-plus trajectories; democratizes data collection
hf:2605.05945.comments: Leveraging commodity smartphone sensors for long-term tracking removes barriers to large-scale egocentric data; open infrastructure accelerates VLA research.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Commodity mobile hardware can enable hour-plus egocentric data collection comparable to specialized robotics setups
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 200 hours collected; processing pipeline validated

hf:2605.16143.task: Autonomous exploration for LLM agents in unfamiliar environments
hf:2605.16143.key_results: Explore-then-Act paradigm improves downstream performance; agents trained with exploration rollouts discover key states and affordances
hf:2605.16143.comments: Formalization of exploration via Checkpoint Coverage metric is useful; interleaving exploration and task rollouts with separate rewards is principled.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Premature exploitation limits agent performance; structured exploration enables better adaptation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; narrow behaviors without exploration

hf:2605.15961.task: Robust fine-tuning of CLIP models via sparse autoencoders
hf:2605.15961.key_results: SAE-FT matches or exceeds state-of-the-art on ImageNet and distribution shift benchmarks; mechanistically transparent and computationally efficient
hf:2605.15961.comments: Regularizing visual representations via SAE-identified features is elegant; interpretability benefit and robustness gains are complementary.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Penalizing semantic feature changes identified by SAE prevents catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; robust performance on distribution shifts

hf:2605.13740.task: Learning POMDP world models from observations with language-model priors
hf:2605.13740.key_results: Pinductor matches sample-efficient POMDP methods assuming privileged state access; significantly surpasses tabular baselines; scales with LLM capability
hf:2605.13740.comments: Using LLM priors to propose and refine POMDP candidates is innovative; belief-based likelihood optimization is principled for partial observability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Language-model priors reduce sample complexity for learning POMDPs from observations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; matches methods with privileged information

hf:2605.13997.task: Learning-free compression of sparse mixture-of-experts via higher-order topology
hf:2605.13997.key_results: HodgeCover identifies harmonic-critical edges and triplet-critical triangles; matches state-of-the-art on expert reduction, leads on aggressive-compression frontier
hf:2605.13997.comments: Detecting irreducible merge cycles via Hodge decomposition is mathematically principled; the topological perspective is novel and exposes structural blindness of pairwise scores.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pairwise merge scores are blind to triplet incompatibilities; Hodge decomposition exposes harmonic kernel
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; hybrid variant leads on aggressive compression

hf:2605.15592.task: Few-step image synthesis with sphere latent encoder
hf:2605.15592.key_results: Outperforms Sphere Encoder on generation quality and inference speed; competitive with strong few-step and multi-step baselines
hf:2605.15592.comments: Decoupling fixed encoder from trainable latent denoiser eliminates pixel-space transitions and resolves reconstruction-generation objective conflict.

model_io.model: Fixed image encoder + latent denoising model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupled architecture improves efficiency and allows specialized optimization of reconstruction and generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms coupled Sphere Encoder

hf:2605.15375.task: Remote sensing change detection via latent rectified flow
hf:2605.15375.key_results: Average F1 of 80.4% across four benchmarks, 1.3 point improvement; supports sampling-based prediction ensembling with confidence estimation
hf:2605.15375.comments: Generative formulation naturally models ambiguity and encourages global consistency; lightweight conditioning in latent space improves efficiency over pixel-space alternatives.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generative formulation with sampling-based ensembling improves robustness and enables confidence estimation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; strong performance and practical confidence metrics

hf:2604.09839.task: Analyzing surjectivity of steered LLM activations
hf:2604.09839.key_results: Activation steering pushes residual stream off manifold of prompt-reachable states; almost surely no prompt reproduces steered behavior
hf:2604.09839.comments: Formalizing the white-box/black-box separation via surjectivity is principled; the result cautions against interpreting steering success as evidence of prompt-based vulnerability.

model_io.model: Large language model with activation steering

hypotheses.hypothesis: Steered activations are not realizable by discrete prompts under practical assumptions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; formal separation proven

hf:2605.15250.task: Hardware-adaptive LLM decoding via group-query latent attention
hf:2605.15250.key_results: GQLA exposes two decoding paths (MQA-absorb and GQA) from same weights; reduces per-token KV cache to 28.125% on MQA path; supports 8-way parallelism
hf:2605.15250.comments: Algebraically equivalent dual paths enable hardware adaptation without retraining; TransGQLA conversion from GQA checkpoints preserves compatibility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two decoding paths in GQLA parameters enable hardware-specific optimization without retraining
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; H100 and H20 rooflines matched

hf:2605.12038.task: Cross-embodiment humanoid video generation with paired-free adaptation
hf:2605.12038.key_results: Strong motion fidelity and embodiment consistency; scalable adaptation to unseen humanoids without retraining shared motion model
hf:2605.12038.comments: Factorizing motion transfer from embodiment adaptation is principled; branch-isolated attention reduces interference between factors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Motion transfer and embodiment adaptation can be decoupled via branch-isolated attention for scalable transfer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; adapts to unseen embodiments without retraining

nature:10.1038/s41567-026-03306-3.task: Characterizing input–output dependencies in neuronal firing without multi-input interactions
nature:10.1038/s41567-026-03306-3.key_results: Simple logistic models capturing individual input dependencies explain most variability in neuronal activity across multiple brain regions and species; inferred neural networks are sparse
nature:10.1038/s41567-026-03306-3.comments: Compelling parsimony result, but 'most variability' leaves open what fraction of circuits critically depend on nonlinear input interactions for computation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Direct input–output dependencies without multi-input interactions are sufficient to explain neuronal activity variability
hypotheses.result: Models without interaction terms predict complex higher-order dependencies and recover known synaptic connectivity features

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neural codes are redundant and robust to perturbations
hypotheses.result: Inferred networks are sparse, consistent with redundancy hypothesis

nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03084-z.task: Infrastructure and methods for predicting macromolecular conformational ensembles
nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03084-z.key_results: No single experimental technique resolves full conformational landscapes; need for integrated heterogeneous experimental data and ensemble-specific validation protocols
nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03084-z.comments: Primarily a roadmap paper identifying gaps rather than demonstrating new predictive capability; highlights critical infrastructure needs but lacks concrete algorithmic advances.

inputs: heterogeneous experimental data (NMR, SAXS, cryo-EM, cross-linking, etc.)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrated encoding of heterogeneous experimental data can create unified ensemble representations suitable for training and validation
hypotheses.result: Methodology proposed but validation deferred; identifies need for benchmarks and ensemble-specific validation protocols

nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02692-7.task: Adaptive control of structured illumination microscopy via physics-guided reinforcement learning
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02692-7.key_results: Improved structural fidelity and frequency recovery on simulated BioSR data; stable under noise, phase detuning, and photobleaching; successful hardware transfer without fine-tuning
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02692-7.comments: Novel integration of differentiable optical models with RL control is elegant, though validation on real biological samples beyond fixed cells and beads would strengthen practical claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive perturbation of illumination parameters within physical bounds improves reconstruction fidelity under imperfect conditions
hypotheses.result: Method maintains stability and improves structural fidelity relative to baselines under noise, phase detuning, and photobleaching

nature:10.1038/s41392-026-02701-9.task: Define VCPIP1-AMPKγ1 deubiquitination axis in diabetic cardiomyopathy pathogenesis
nature:10.1038/s41392-026-02701-9.key_results: VCPIP1 catalyzes K63-linked deubiquitination of AMPKγ1-K234, disrupting AMPKα-γ heterodimer assembly and blocking LKB1-mediated AMPKαT172 phosphorylation; VCPIP1 knockout in cardiomyocytes ameliorated cardiac damage in type 1 and type 2 diabetic mice
nature:10.1038/s41392-026-02701-9.comments: Elegant mechanistic dissection identifying a non-canonical AMPK regulation axis, though the therapeutic window for selective VCPIP1 inhibition without off-target effects requires further validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: VCPIP1 deubiquitinates AMPKγ1 to impair AMPK activation in diabetic hearts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; VCPIP1 catalyzes K63-deubiquitination at AMPKγ1-K234 via C218 residue, preventing AMPKα-γ assembly

hypotheses.hypothesis: AMPKγ1-K234 ubiquitination is required for proper AMPK assembly and T172 phosphorylation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; K234R mutation phenocopies VCPIP1-mediated pathology in db/db mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: VCPIP1 inhibition restores mitochondrial respiration in diabetic cardiomyocytes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; VCPIP1 knockout reversed hyperglycemia-induced mitochondrial dysfunction

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46054-3.task: Investigate Ginsenoside Rh4 protective mechanisms in septic cardiomyopathy
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46054-3.key_results: Rh4 reduced mortality in septic mice, improved ejection fraction and diastolic function, shifted macrophage polarization from M1 to M2 phenotype, and decreased ROS production via Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway activation
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-46054-3.comments: Multi-level mechanistic validation (transcriptomics, flow cytometry, ELISA) supports therapeutic potential, though human translational efficacy remains uncertain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rh4 improves cardiac function through NF-κB pathway inhibition and macrophage polarization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduced M1 macrophages and pro-inflammatory cytokines with increased M2 macrophages

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rh4 reduces cardiomyocyte oxidative stress via Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ROS decreased in HL-1 cells with pathway activation demonstrated

nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10289-7.task: Characterize pcdh15 paralog function in zebrafish mechanosensory and photoreceptor cells
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10289-7.key_results: Double pcdh15a/b mutants show loss of kinocilial/stereocilial links in hair cells and disorganized calyceal processes with photoreceptor cell death; both paralogs expressed in ear and eye despite prior reports of tissue-specific restriction
nature:10.1038/s42003-026-10289-7.comments: Demonstrates that paralog compensation studies require double mutants to reveal true gene function, with direct relevance to modeling human USH1F where only one PCDH15 ortholog exists.

hypotheses.hypothesis: pcdh15a and pcdh15b paralogs have tissue-restricted, non-overlapping functions
hypotheses.result: Refuted; both paralogs expressed and functional in hair cells and photoreceptors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Double mutants reveal more severe phenotypes than single mutants
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; double mutants show complete loss of mechanotransduction links and photoreceptor degeneration

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73094-0.task: Automated diagnostic classification of lateral flow tests for schistosomiasis
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73094-0.key_results: 86.6% sensitivity and 96.5% specificity vs. senior technician readings; classification in ~5 min for high antigen
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73094-0.comments: Well-motivated application of deep learning and signal processing to resolve interpretability in point-of-care diagnostics, with clear clinical utility for WHO target profiles.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visual trace ambiguity can be resolved by signal processing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ambiguous traces correctly classified as negative

nature:10.1038/s41551-026-01676-w.task: Explainability enhancement for medical AI via class-association manifold learning
nature:10.1038/s41551-026-01676-w.key_results: Method decouples class patterns from individual backgrounds; near-perfect diagnostic accuracy retained; generates virtual contrastive examples and decision rule topology
nature:10.1038/s41551-026-01676-w.comments: Generative approach to explainability is novel; successfully bridges interpretability gap while maintaining accuracy, though scalability to high-dimensional medical data is not discussed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Class-association manifolds enhance medical AI explainability without sacrificing diagnostic accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; method extracts medically-compliant knowledge and enables intuitive decision rule visualization

nature:10.1038/s41576-026-00969-9.task: Computational methods for multimodal lineage tracing and trajectory inference
nature:10.1038/s41576-026-00969-9.key_results: Survey of methodologies for lineage-resolved single-cell multi-omics; emerging deep learning approaches enable ancestral state estimation and molecular program identification
nature:10.1038/s41576-026-00969-9.comments: Comprehensive review of computational landscape; identifies integration of heterogeneous lineage marks and multi-omics as major challenge; no novel algorithms or empirical results presented.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning on multimodal lineage-tracing data enables accurate trajectory and fate decision inference
hypotheses.result: Partial confirmation; emerging methods show promise but benchmarks and ground-truth validation remain limited

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48754-2.task: Cross-platform comparison of cancer hotspot proteins in breast and kidney tumors
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48754-2.key_results: RPPA and LC-MS show partial agreement (protein-dependent); some targets concordant, others discordant
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-48754-2.comments: Important cautionary finding highlighting that RPPA and LC-MS are not interchangeable; emphasizes need for confirmatory approaches in biomarker validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: RPPA and LC-MS yield concordant tumor/normal fold changes for all targets

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72885-9.key_results: Non-1/B oscillations observed down to 700 mK and 60 T in ZrTe₅; violates Lifshitz-Kosevich framework; nonlinear Landau-level back-bending from cyclotron-spin-orbit coupling interplay explains all observed regimes
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72885-9.comments: The nonlinear Landau-level picture provides a unified framework for previously disparate oscillation phenomena in Dirac systems, elegantly explaining anomalies through band-bending rather than many-body effects.

inputs: three-dimensional Dirac Hamiltonian with spin-orbit coupling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Anomalous magnetoresistance in ZrTe₅ requires many-body interactions
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; nonlinear Landau-level back-bending in non-interacting Dirac system reproduces all observed oscillation types

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73460-y.task: Understanding anomalous nonlinear soliton pumping in topological systems
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73460-y.key_results: Soliton displacement differs from Bloch band Chern number; nonlinearity-induced integer-quantized pumping achieves one unit cell travel in topologically trivial bands
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73460-y.comments: The finding that solitons can pump anomalously via Wannier function transitions challenges conventional topological pump theory and opens new avenues for nonlinear transport.

inputs: system parameter variation over pump period

hypotheses.hypothesis: Soliton pumping depends only on Chern number of bifurcating band
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; anomalous pumping arises from Wannier function transitions bypassing Chern constraint

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73493-3.task: Observing Kondo cloud coupling in mirror-symmetric carbon nanotube-molybdenum heterostructures
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73493-3.key_results: Kondo temperature exhibits two plateaus at ~107.8 K and ~15.8 K depending on Mo strip width (0.3-1.2 µm vs. 1.5-3.0 µm); two-spin model reproduces plateaus and crossover via intra-edge and inter-edge coupling
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73493-3.comments: The experimental observation of Kondo cloud coupling provides direct evidence of the Kondo screening cloud, though the microscopic mechanism of Mo's role in mediating inter-edge coupling warrants further theoretical clarification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Kondo screening clouds in isolated systems do not interact
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; Kondo clouds couple via Mo interlayer, producing width-dependent plateau structure in Kondo temperature

nature:10.1038/s41524-026-02059-0.task: Computing band gaps of periodic materials using sample-based quantum diagonalization on NISQ devices
nature:10.1038/s41524-026-02059-0.key_results: Quantum-computed band gaps for HfO₂ and ZrO₂ agree with experimental measurements; method outperforms DFT benchmarks; predictions obtained in pre-fault-tolerant quantum hardware regime
nature:10.1038/s41524-026-02059-0.comments: The demonstration of experimentally verifiable band gap predictions from NISQ hardware is a significant milestone for quantum-classical hybrid materials simulation, though the method's applicability to transition metals and more complex materials remains to be explored.

inputs: lattice Hamiltonian with self-consistent electronic parameters

hypotheses.hypothesis: DFT provides accurate band gap predictions for wide-gap dielectrics without correlation corrections
hypotheses.result: Rejected; quantum-classical hybrid simulation outperforms DFT and agrees with experimental band gaps

nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01277-0.task: Achieving super-Heisenberg scaling in quantum metrology via nonlinear quantum scrambling
nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01277-0.key_results: Nonlinear quantum scrambling enables T⁻β super-Heisenberg scaling with time-independent Hamiltonian; exponential precision improvement achievable in dissipative optical cavity with external and intracavity squeezing
nature:10.1038/s41534-026-01277-0.comments: The work demonstrates that nonlinear resources can bypass the need for many-body Hamiltonian terms to achieve super-Heisenberg scaling, offering practical advantages for quantum sensing in realistic dissipative systems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Super-Heisenberg scaling requires many-body interactions or time-dependent Hamiltonians
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; nonlinear quantum scrambling achieves super-Heisenberg scaling with time-independent generators even in dissipative systems

nature:10.1038/s41535-026-00900-9.task: Elucidating interrelations between weak ferromagnetism, anomalous Hall conductivity, and orbital magnetization in altermagnetic systems
nature:10.1038/s41535-026-00900-9.key_results: Weak spin ferromagnetism induced by uniform-sign Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions; σxy and orbital magnetization linked to sign-alternating interactions; band structure remains spin-degenerate despite time-reversal symmetry breaking
nature:10.1038/s41535-026-00900-9.comments: The microscopic model elegantly demonstrates that anomalous Hall effect in antiferromagnets arises from non-spin-canting interactions, broadening the toolkit for designing magnetic materials with Hall responses.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spin-canting mechanisms explain anomalous Hall conductivity in antiferromagnets
hypotheses.result: Rejected; σxy arises from sign-alternating DMI interactions that do not induce spin canting; orthorhombic strain is more relevant

nature:10.1038/s41563-026-02617-3.task: Measuring quantum metric of topological insulator surface states via nonlinear magnetoresistance
nature:10.1038/s41563-026-02617-3.key_results: Time-reversal-odd nonlinear magnetoresistance independent of temperature and scattering time below 30 K confirms intrinsic geometric origin; tunable via gate voltage controlling top/bottom surface state contributions
nature:10.1038/s41563-026-02617-3.comments: The observation of quantum metric-induced nonlinear transport provides direct experimental evidence for geometric response in topological phases, demonstrating practical tunability relevant for device engineering.

model_io.model: Sb₂Te₃ topological insulator with top/bottom surface states

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nonlinear magnetoresistance in topological insulators arises primarily from Berry curvature
hypotheses.result: Partially revised; quantum metric provides significant intrinsic contribution independent of scattering, demonstrating distinct geometric origin from Berry curvature

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50688-8.task: Analyzing gravitational collapse of radiating relativistic stars with shear using bifurcation analysis
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50688-8.key_results: Junction conditions reduce to Riccati-type ODE admitting exact solutions; fold bifurcations emerge with shear; areal distance plays central role in asymptotic behavior intertwined with charge and cosmological constant
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50688-8.comments: The phase plane analysis reveals that shear fundamentally alters collapse dynamics compared to shear-free models, but the physical interpretation of the bifurcation points in terms of observable astrophysical outcomes could be strengthened.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shear does not qualitatively alter collapse dynamics from shear-free models
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; shear induces fold bifurcations and distinct evolution pathways absent in shear-free cases

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51383-4.task: Characterizing optical and luminescence properties of Sm₂O₃-doped lithium borate glasses under heat treatment
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51383-4.key_results: Optical band gap increased by up to 10%; crystal sizes reduced to nanoscale (≤18 nm); excitation peak shifts 393→403 nm, emission peak 596→600 nm
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-51383-4.comments: The study demonstrates tunable photoluminescence through heat-treatment-induced crystallization, with practical applications in laser and white-light emission, though the mechanism linking crystal phase composition to color temperature shifts could be clearer.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increasing heat treatment temperature monotonically increases optical properties
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; transmittance shows non-monotonic behavior near Tg and Tc; intensity increases with temperature but decay time decreases

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54123-w.task: Developing neural network models for proton relative biological effectiveness (RBE)
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54123-w.key_results: NN models with LET, (α/β)ₓ, and Dx(SF) inputs show best performance; standardized survival fraction parameter Dx(0.1-0.2) improves prediction; comparable RBE dependencies to published models
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54123-w.comments: The assumption-free NN approach validates existing RBE frameworks while demonstrating that photon dose sensitivity is a critical overlooked input parameter for clinical proton therapy dose calculation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Proton RBE depends only on LET
hypotheses.result: Insufficient; adding (α/β)ₓ and Dx(SF) substantially improves model performance and predictive power

nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02695-4.task: Suppressing decoherence in hybrid magnetic quantum networks via Floquet engineering
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02695-4.key_results: Floquet-engineering via periodic driving on NV centers and magnon modes suppresses lattice-induced decoherence; steady-state entanglement preserved when Floquet bound state exists in quasienergy spectrum
nature:10.1038/s42005-026-02695-4.comments: The proposal leverages Floquet physics to mitigate decoherence in hybrid magnetic systems, though experimental demonstration remains outstanding and the scalability of the approach to larger quantum networks is unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid magnetic lattices inevitably increase decoherence in quantum nodes
hypotheses.result: Partially overcome; Floquet engineering via periodic driving can suppress decoherence by creating bound states in quasienergy spectrum

nature:10.1038/s44306-026-00150-2.task: Studying critical phenomena on 3D fractal lattices with tunable Hausdorff dimension via tensor-network methods
nature:10.1038/s44306-026-00150-2.key_results: Ising model on dH=2.5 fractal exhibits phase transition at Tc≈2.65231 with exotic critical exponents (β≈0.059, δ≈35); logarithmic singularity in specific heat (α=0); absent in lower-dimensional fractals
nature:10.1038/s44306-026-00150-2.comments: The work demonstrates that fractal dimensionality is an effective tuning parameter for magnetic criticality, opening a novel materials design paradigm, though the practical realization of such fractals and their magnetic properties remains speculative.

model_io.model: Classical Ising model on 3D fractal lattice
inputs: 3D static spin cluster with Hausdorff dimension dH=2.5

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fractal geometry does not produce critical phenomena qualitatively distinct from translationally invariant lattices
hypotheses.result: Rejected; fractal Hausdorff dimension dH=2.5 produces exotic critical exponents and logarithmic specific heat anomaly absent in lower-dimensional systems

nature:10.1038/s44310-026-00120-w.task: Modulating emission of perovskite nanocrystals via bound states in the continuum in silicon gratings
nature:10.1038/s44310-026-00120-w.key_results: Sixfold photoluminescence enhancement via Si grating integration; selective wavelength enhancement and shaping achieved; directional emission and excitation-position-dependent control demonstrated
nature:10.1038/s44310-026-00120-w.comments: The integration of perovskite NCs with engineered dielectric metasurfaces via bound states in the continuum provides practical controls for light-matter coupling, though the scalability to large-area visible-range devices and stability under operational conditions need evaluation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Perovskite NC emission is insensitive to underlying dielectric nanostructure resonances
hypotheses.result: Rejected; bound states in the continuum in Si gratings produce significant PL enhancement and spectral shaping via strong light-matter coupling

nature:10.1038/s44310-026-00124-6.task: Reviewing longitudinally structured beams for underwater optical ranging in turbid media
nature:10.1038/s44310-026-00124-6.key_results: Bessel-Gaussian modes with orbital angular momentum exhibit rotation-based distance retrieval; continuous-wave operation eliminates need for high-bandwidth modulation; suitable for turbid environments
nature:10.1038/s44310-026-00124-6.comments: The perspective highlights a promising alternative paradigm for underwater ranging exploiting spatial mode structure rather than temporal information, though practical implementation challenges and comparison with acoustic systems merit deeper exploration.

inputs: Bessel-Gaussian structured beam with orbital angular momentum

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial structure of optical beams is degraded too rapidly in scattering media to enable accurate ranging
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; rotation angle of structured beams can be retrieved accurately even in high-turbidity environments

nature:10.1038/s44310-026-00127-3.task: Reviewing achromatic metalens design paradigms and performance trade-offs across visible-infrared spectrum
nature:10.1038/s44310-026-00127-3.key_results: Four achromatization paradigms identified: dispersion engineering, algorithm-aided design, architecture modification, and wavefront engineering; trade-offs identified among bandwidth, NA, aperture size, and efficiency
nature:10.1038/s44310-026-00127-3.comments: The unified framework is conceptually useful for categorizing diverse achromatization strategies, but the roadmap toward centimeter-scale, high-efficiency broadband metalenses remains aspirational without concrete fabrication breakthroughs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromatic aberration in metalenses cannot be simultaneously eliminated across visible-infrared with high NA and large aperture
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; fundamental trade-offs exist; each paradigm makes different performance compromises

nature:10.1038/s44334-026-00089-6.task: Predicting thermal and material flow fields in additive friction stir deposition via Bayesian learning
nature:10.1038/s44334-026-00089-6.key_results: Sequential Bayesian framework achieves 3D field predictions in ~1 second (vs. 8 hours for CFD); consistently outperforms benchmark ML models; uncertainty reduces with new experimental data
nature:10.1038/s44334-026-00089-6.comments: The measurement-informed Bayesian approach elegantly combines physics-based simulations with sparse in situ thermal imaging to enable real-time process control, though the scalability to other AM processes remains undemonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-based models alone predict thermal and flow fields accurately
hypotheses.result: Insufficient without measurement integration; Bayesian learning reduces computational cost and uncertainty by combining physics with experimental data

hf:2605.22681.task: Forecasting scientific progress and discovery timelines
hf:2605.22681.key_results: Across 4,760 scientific events, models identify plausible directions but fail to predict realization or timing reliably; AI progress more predictable than biology/chemistry/physics; performance insensitive to training cutoff
hf:2605.22681.comments: Reveals fundamental limitations in AI forecasting that transcend data exposure, suggesting architectural or reasoning constraints in forward prediction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Knowledge cutoff explains poor forecasting performance
hypotheses.result: Rejected—performance insensitive to pre/post-cutoff events; additional pre-cutoff knowledge helps but doesn't close gap

hypotheses.hypothesis: Models can reliably predict scientific progress
hypotheses.result: False—systematic domain-dependent limitations and overconfidence observed across all frontier models

hf:2605.22668.task: High-resolution image generation beyond training resolution
hf:2605.22668.key_results: SEGA consistently improves synthesis across multiple target resolutions, outperforming training-free baselines in structural coherence and fine-detail fidelity
hf:2605.22668.comments: Training-free approach is practical, but gains appear incremental over existing RoPE extrapolation methods.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Uniform RoPE scaling across frequency components is suboptimal
hypotheses.result: True—adaptive frequency-dependent scaling via SEGA improves both structure and detail

hf:2605.18607.task: Early-stage forecasting of downstream LLM performance without expensive evaluation
hf:2605.18607.key_results: Proxy metrics rank reasoning models with Spearman ρ=0.81 vs ρ=0.36 for loss; rank corpora at 10,000× less compute; extrapolate accuracy over 18× compute horizon with half existing error
hf:2605.18607.comments: Expert trajectory signals are remarkably robust across diverse settings, suggesting a general principle for model capability assessment.

outputs: proxy metrics (entropy, top-k accuracy, expert token rank)

hypotheses.result: True across model selection, data selection, and training-time forecasting
