hf:2605.22138.task: Efficient agentic reasoning through adaptive planning
hf:2605.22138.key_results: SR²AM v0.1-8B and v1.0-30B match 120-355B and 685B-1T parameter systems respectively while using 25.8-95.3% fewer reasoning tokens; RL increases planning horizon 22.8% with only 2.0% increase in frequency
hf:2605.22138.comments: Elegant three-system decomposition (simulative reasoning, self-regulation, reactive execution) shows RL learns strategic planning depth rather than frequency—a clean insight into efficient agency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-regulation should increase planning frequency when needed
hypotheses.result: Partially—RL learns to plan deeper (22.8% horizon increase) rather than more often (2.0% frequency increase), suggesting learned selectivity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive computation without explicit control leads to inefficient token use
hypotheses.result: True—implicit planning dramatically increases length without guaranteed accuracy gains

hf:2605.22715.task: Setup-agnostic human motion understanding from wearable IMU sensors
hf:2605.22715.key_results: Improves zero-shot activity recognition accuracy/F1 by 11.7%/11.6% across 14 datasets; increases IMU-to-text and text-to-IMU retrieval MRR by 15.9% and 28.6%; improves captioning BERT-F1 by 18.8%
hf:2605.22715.comments: Physics-grounded simulation for synthetic data generation elegantly sidesteps device heterogeneity; LLM alignment for motion-language understanding is well-motivated but token design choice could be explored further.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-grounded IMU simulation enables setup-agnostic pretraining
hypotheses.result: True—zero-shot transfer across 14 unseen datasets and cross-modal retrieval improved significantly

hypotheses.hypothesis: Setup dependence fundamentally limits wearable IMU transfer
hypotheses.result: Partially mitigated—geometric framework and synthetic data substantially improve but don't eliminate domain gaps

hf:2605.21363.task: Attribution of AI contributions to goal-shaping in human-AI collaboration
hf:2605.21363.key_results: Models contribute 11-26% of goal-shaping but substantially more on concrete requirements; interaction design significantly affects behavior; exposing goal-level analysis shifts perceived contribution by ~2 points on 5-point scale
hf:2605.21363.comments: Critical insight that users systematically miscalibrate their reliance on AI when exposed to process-level rather than artifact-level analysis; raises important UX implications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs make minimal goal-shaping contributions
hypotheses.result: Partially true—11-26% direct contribution, but substantial indirect influences and lower-level requirement contributions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Users accurately perceive AI contribution without explicit process analysis
hypotheses.result: False—perceived contribution shifts ~2 points when exposed to goal-level analysis vs artifact-level assessment

hf:2605.20496.task: Discovering universal shared geometry across human visual cortex representations
hf:2605.20496.key_results: Subject-specific fMRI embeddings translate across individuals via unsupervised orthogonal rotations; pairwise rotations synchronize into single shared latent space; cross-subject retrieval improves with canonical coordinate system
hf:2605.20496.comments: Elegant self-supervised approach leveraging repeated stimuli; finding suggests visual cortex representations are approximately isometric across subjects—parallels AI model convergence but in biological neural networks.

inputs: fMRI timeseries from repeated natural scene presentations (multi-subject)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Human visual cortex representations converge to universal geometry
hypotheses.result: True—subject-specific spaces are mutually isometric and translatable via geometric transformations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Paired cross-subject samples are necessary for alignment
hypotheses.result: False—unsupervised orthogonal rotations suffice, without cross-subject pairing

hf:2605.20405.task: Class-imbalanced medical image segmentation with emphasis on rare tissue classes
hf:2605.20405.key_results: Under full-data training, episodic/random/weighted comparable (Dice 0.882/0.878/0.878); under low-data, episodic superior (0.787 vs 0.758/0.762); under matched iterations, episodic improves 3× longer before plateauing
hf:2605.20405.comments: Key contribution is identifying training iteration budget as confound—highlights importance of iteration-matched evaluation protocols; implicit regularization of class-balanced batches is elegant alternative to loss reweighting.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Episodic sampling enables better class-imbalanced segmentation
hypotheses.result: True under low-data and matched-iteration settings; equivalent under full-data, suggesting training budget is confound

hypotheses.hypothesis: Class-balanced batch construction provides implicit regularization
hypotheses.result: True—episodic sampling shows extended improvement trajectory vs early overfitting in baselines

hf:2605.22552.task: Versatile fashion image retrieval across diverse query formats and search intentions
hf:2605.22552.key_results: FashionLens achieves state-of-the-art across diverse retrieval scenarios in U-FIRE benchmark; robust generalization to unseen tasks
hf:2605.22552.comments: Multimodal LLM foundation is appropriate for diverse query intents; spherical query calibration mechanism is somewhat complex relative to stated gains—ablation would clarify contribution.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified framework can handle diverse fashion retrieval scenarios
hypotheses.result: True—state-of-the-art across multiple task types with single model

hypotheses.result: True—dynamic re-weighting based on learning difficulty and data scale improves performance

hf:2605.07604.task: Promptable 3D reconstruction of multiple animals from single image
hf:2605.07604.key_results: State-of-the-art over model-based and model-free methods on Animal3D, APTv2, Animal Kingdom; supports flexible keypoint/mask prompts for disambiguation in crowded/occluded scenes
hf:2605.07604.comments: First multi-animal 3D reconstruction framework with prompt interface is valuable contribution; Herd3D dataset fills real gap, though scale (5K images) remains modest for pretraining.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parametric animal models enable multi-instance reconstruction
hypotheses.result: True—joint reconstruction with flexible prompts handles occlusion and crowding

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic occlusion/interaction data improves wild performance
hypotheses.result: Likely true (implied by method design), but direct ablation not explicitly reported

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73602-2.task: Determine structure of ALECT2 amyloid filaments from patient biopsies
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73602-2.key_results: Six-layered fold structure consistent across 5 patients; all 133 residues of mature LECT2 incorporated into filament core with native disulfide bonds preserved

hypotheses.hypothesis: Limited epitope accessibility explains variable immunohistochemical detection

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73417-1.task: Elucidate the role of chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA) in regulatory T cell function and peripheral tolerance
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73417-1.key_results: CMA activity increases upon Treg activation; Treg-specific CMA-deficient mice display chronic inflammation and reduced survival with age; CMA-deficient Tregs show reduced suppressive activity in IBD and tumor models; CMA substrate proteomic analysis revealed modulation of pathways sustaining Treg homeostasis

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53040-2.task: Determine synergistic antitumor effects of dexamethasone combined with cold atmospheric-pressure plasma in lung adenocarcinoma

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53398-3.task: Determine the role of LYL1 transcription factor in adult hematopoietic stem cell-derived lymphopoiesis

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50041-z.task: Blockchain-based resilient demand-side management in smart grids

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50539-6.task: Cooperative DCSK relay performance over fading channels
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-50539-6.key_results: Analytical expressions developed for outage probability and capacity; Nakagami-m parameter significantly impacts performance

hf:2604.20665.task: Evaluating trustworthiness of multimodal reasoning in VLMs

hf:2604.20665.comments: Argues current VLMs lack genuine multimodal reasoning; proposes moving beyond 'multimodal gain' metric to semantic sufficiency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: State-of-the-art VLMs exploit language priors to bypass visual representation bottlenecks; scaling language increases penalty of visual bottleneck
hypotheses.result: Modality Translation Protocol reveals functional blindness; language priors dominate vision input

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72986-5.task: Characterize HBx-Spindlin1 interaction and mechanism of Spindlin1 inhibition
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72986-5.key_results: HBx1-120 undergoes disorder-to-order transition upon Spindlin1 binding; forms bivalent complex via hydrophobic interaction and inter-molecular zinc finger that masks Spindlin1's histone-tail recruiting region
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-72986-5.comments: The inter-molecular zinc finger is a rare structural feature that may represent a viral adaptation for hijacking host epigenetic machinery.

hypotheses.hypothesis: HBx1-120 is disordered in isolation but folds locally upon Spindlin1 binding
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via NMR; bivalent complex stabilized by hydrophobic interaction and inter-molecular zinc finger

hypotheses.hypothesis: HBx masks Spindlin1's histone-tail recruiting region to suppress transcriptional control
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mechanism promotes viral DNA transcription while evading antiviral defense

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73711-y.task: Elucidate MCUb's lack of calcium conductance and its role as a uniporter inhibitor
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73711-y.key_results: MCUb reaches ~80% of MCU conductance when EMRE binding is restored and NTD autoinhibition is relieved; wild-type MCUb exhibits ~30% of the inhibitory capacity of a pore-disrupting E249A variant
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73711-y.comments: The finding that MCUb is only a modest negative regulator suggests more complex regulatory mechanisms may compensate for uniporter attenuation in vivo.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MCUb lacks conductance due to inability to bind EMRE and NTD-mediated autoinhibition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; restoring EMRE binding and relieving NTD inhibition recovers ~80% of MCU activity

hypotheses.hypothesis: MCUb functions as a potent negative regulator of the uniporter
hypotheses.result: Refuted; MCUb exhibits only ~30% of the inhibitory capacity of the pore-disrupting E249A variant

nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03093-y.task: Automate high-throughput cryo-electron tomography preprocessing with real-time correction and denoising
nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03093-y.key_results: AreTomo3 enables comprehensive contrast transfer function correction accounting for sample geometry; DenoisET retains intermediate-resolution features during denoising; pipeline supports preprocessing concurrent with data collection at scale
nature:10.1038/s41592-026-03093-y.comments: The integration of real-time processing with data collection alleviates a key bottleneck in cryo-ET, though the tradeoff between automation and manual quality control oversight requires careful validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Accounting for sample geometry enables comprehensive local correction of contrast transfer function
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AreTomo3 implements sample-geometry-aware CTF correction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intermediate-resolution features can be preferentially retained during denoising
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DenoisET leverages comprehensively corrected tomograms for selective contrast enhancement

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53440-4.task: Develop label-free, mass-resolved single-molecule immunoassay platform
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53440-4.key_results: iSCAT detects individual antibody-antigen binding events with molecular-weight discrimination; measured IgM association rates scale linearly with concentration over three orders of magnitude; measured koff from single-molecule dwell times; serum IgM concentrations agree with ELISA
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-53440-4.comments: The ability to measure elementary kinetic constants (kon, koff) directly from individual binding trajectories represents a significant advance over ensemble methods, though applicability to complex multiplex assays remains to be demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single protein-protein binding events can be directly observed label-free via scattered light intensity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; iSCAT resolves discrete antibody-antigen interactions with single-molecule sensitivity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Association rates scale linearly with antigen concentration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed over three orders of magnitude concentration range

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-molecule dwell time distributions yield dissociation rate constants comparable to ensemble methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; measured koff from iSCAT agrees with ELISA-derived concentrations in serum

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54958-3.task: Model LET- and oxygen-dependent hydroxyl radical production under ionizing radiation
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54958-3.key_results: Closed-form analytical model predicts hydroxyl radical density as a function of LET and oxygen; identifies three radiochemical regimes (production-limited, scavenging-limited, track-structure-dominated) that emerge naturally from model structure
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54958-3.comments: The analytical tractability and physical transparency make this suitable for multiscale integration, though it deliberately does not predict biological damage endpoints.

model_io.model: LET-dependent reaction-kinetics model with Boltzmann-P1 approximation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hydroxyl radical availability is suppressed with increasing LET
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; model systematically replicates suppression of indirect chemical activity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Three distinct radiochemical regimes emerge from production-scavenging-track-density interplay
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; production-limited, scavenging-limited, and track-structure-dominated regimes predicted naturally

nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01760-3.task: Define ADAR1 lactylation as a driver of ovarian cancer chemoresistance and develop targeted therapeutic strategy
nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01760-3.key_results: Cisplatin-resistant cells show elevated global A-to-I RNA editing and ADAR1 expression; Tip60 mediates ADAR1 lactylation to stabilize ADAR1 via USP48; ADAR1 inhibitor ZYS-1 reduces ADAR1 expression, activates MAVS/PKR innate immunity, and synergizes with cisplatin in vivo
nature:10.1038/s41418-026-01760-3.comments: Novel lactylation-mediated epigenetic mechanism in chemoresistance with clear therapeutic opportunity; comprehensive mechanistic characterization and promising in vivo efficacy.

model_io.model: ovarian cancer cells (resistant and sensitive phenotypes)

hypotheses.hypothesis: ADAR1 lactylation is elevated in cisplatin-resistant ovarian cancer and drives chemoresistance
hypotheses.result: Cisplatin-resistant cells exhibit high global A-to-I editing and ADAR1 expression; ADAR1 knockdown enhances cisplatin sensitivity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tip60-mediated ADAR1 lactylation stabilizes ADAR1 protein through USP48 interaction
hypotheses.result: Tip60 mediates ADAR1 lactylation; lactylation facilitates ADAR1-USP48 interaction for stabilization

hypotheses.hypothesis: ADAR1 lactylation suppresses innate immunity and enhances protein translation, driving chemoresistance
hypotheses.result: ADAR1 upregulation suppresses MAVS/PKR pathways and increases protein translation; ZYS-1 reverses these effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: ZYS-1 plus cisplatin synergizes to overcome chemoresistance in vivo
hypotheses.result: Combination treatment delays tumor growth and promotes CD4+/CD8+ T cell infiltration better than single agents

nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03142-7.task: Identify ATP2B4 as a driver of pancreatic cancer radiotherapy resistance through chromatin compaction regulation
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03142-7.key_results: ATP2B4 knockout induces chromatin decompaction and increases RT-induced apoptosis; ATP2B4 stabilizes ELAVL1 which maintains histone H1.0 mRNA stability
nature:10.1038/s41420-026-03142-7.comments: Novel connection between calcium ATPase and chromatin remodeling in radioresistance; potential clinical biomarker and therapeutic target with clear mechanistic pathway.

model_io.model: CRISPR screening, pancreatic cancer cells in vitro and in vivo

hypotheses.hypothesis: ATP2B4 promotes chromatin compaction and radioresistance
hypotheses.result: ATP2B4 knockout causes chromatin decompaction and sensitizes cells to radiation

hypotheses.hypothesis: ATP2B4 regulates histone H1.0 through ELAVL1 stabilization
hypotheses.result: ATP2B4 stabilizes ELAVL1 protein, which enhances histone H1.0 mRNA stability

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73471-9.task: Determine role of noncanonical autophagy in epithelial lumen formation during neural tube morphogenesis
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73471-9.key_results: CASM-dependent V-ATPase/ATG16L1 axis is essential for single-lumen resolution; coordinates junctional remodeling and phosphoinositide transitions
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73471-9.comments: Elegant use of organoid and micropattern systems to dissect noncanonical autophagy function, though mechanistic details of Rab pathway coordination remain partially defined.

hypotheses.hypothesis: V-ATPase/ATG16L1 axis regulates membrane remodeling through junctional and endocytic pathways
hypotheses.result: CASM coordinates LC3 lipidation on endocytic compartments, Rab-dependent trafficking, and phosphoinositide transitions

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49198-4.task: Determine role of FNDC5/irisin in placental development and fetal-placental interactions during pregnancy
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49198-4.key_results: FNDC5 KO dams showed increased maternal body weight and reduced fetal-to-placental weight ratio; knockout placentas exhibited reduced labyrinth markers, altered glucose transporter expression, and changed CD31 vascularization
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-49198-4.comments: Demonstrates FNDC5 importance in maternal-placental adaptation without causing pregnancy failure, suggesting compensatory mechanisms exist.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Irisin regulates placental nutrient transport, energy storage, and vascular development

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54070-6.task: Evaluate p-Synephrine delivery via titanium-organic framework and exosomes in suppressing periodontitis-associated inflammation through PI3K/mTOR pathway inhibition
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54070-6.key_results: p-Synephrine-loaded exosomes (P-SYN-Exo) most effectively increased antioxidant markers (GPx, SOD, TAC), reduced pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-4, IL-6, TNF-α), and decreased PI3K/mTOR pathway markers; NH2−MIL-125 and exosomes enhanced controlled release and bioavailability
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54070-6.comments: Promising multi-modal delivery strategy for anti-inflammatory therapy; results in cell culture models warrant in vivo validation for clinical translation.

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54226-4.task: Evaluate helium cold atmospheric plasma effects on colorectal cancer stem cell self-renewal and stemness
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54226-4.key_results: CAP exposure reduced HT-29 CSC spheroid diameter by 65% at 240 s (247 μm to 87 μm, p<0.0001) and suppressed self-renewal capacity; H₂O₂ accumulated in time-dependent manner; OCT4 expression increased 2-fold while SOX2 and NANOG unchanged
nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54226-4.comments: Demonstrates ROS-mediated suppression of CSC self-renewal, though heterogeneous stemness gene responses warrant mechanistic clarification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CAP-generated H₂O₂ reduces CSC viability and self-renewal in time-dependent manner

hypotheses.hypothesis: CAP suppresses stemness gene expression uniformly

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54516-x.task: Integrate single-cell and bulk transcriptomics to identify lactylation-related genes in benign prostatic hyperplasia and define ANXA2 function

nature:10.1038/s41598-026-54526-9.task: Develop benchmarking pipeline for predicting cell responses to perturbations affecting both gene expression and cellular abundance

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71607-5.task: Mitochondrial lineage tracing for somatic cell evolution inference

hf:2605.27762.task: Parametric embodied agent memory via contrastive internalization
hf:2605.27762.key_results: PEAM improves long-horizon task performance; mitigates forgetting on consolidated skills; faster execution than retrieval-based agents

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71878-y.task: Characterize intracellular heat dissipation mechanisms and temperature distribution dynamics
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71878-y.key_results: Intracellular temperature relaxation occurs over seconds (significantly slower than liposomes), driven by non-diffusive heat dissipation rather than conventional heat conduction
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-71878-y.comments: The discovery of non-diffusive heat dissipation mechanisms in cells challenges classical thermodynamic models and suggests intracellular heterogeneity plays a crucial role in thermal dynamics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intracellular heat dissipation follows classical heat conduction similar to liposomes
hypotheses.result: Rejected; cells show significantly slower temperature relaxation than liposomes, indicating non-diffusive mechanisms

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; heat dissipation is impacted by intracellular organization beyond simple diffusion

nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73135-8.task: Elucidate molecular mechanism of tRNA-dependent sterol aspartylation by ErdS
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73135-8.key_results: Cryo-EM structures reveal tRNA-guided intramolecular aminoacyl transfer with CCA end displacement to reach catalytic site; Erg-Asp required for hyphal growth, sporulation, and spore germination
nature:10.1038/s41467-026-73135-8.comments: The swinging-arm mechanism using tRNA as a mobile prosthetic group is elegant and represents an unusual catalytic strategy in sterol modification biology.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ergosteryl-aspartate is functionally inert
hypotheses.result: Rejected; Erg-Asp is required for proper hyphal growth, sporulation, stress tolerance

hypotheses.hypothesis: tRNA acts as a simple substrate carrier in sterol modification
hypotheses.result: Refined; tRNA undergoes dynamic repositioning with CCA end displacement, functioning as a guided swinging arm for intramolecular aminoacyl transfer

nature:10.1038/s41419-026-08881-0.task: Determine role of neddylation (UBE2M-mediated) in stabilizing VEGFR2 to delay pulmonary vascular senescence
